function pgPlayerWhy(){if(actHasCert('PORT-PASS'))return 'היתר כניסה לנמל';const m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;if(m&&pgMissionTouches(m.id))return 'משימה בנמל';const w=State.pgWorkPass;if(w&&SIM.t<w.until)return 'כניסת עבודה · עוד '+Math.ceil((w.until-SIM.t)/60)+' דק׳';return null}
function pgCoreAuthorized(v){const c=v.c2;if(!c)return false;if(c.profile==='bus')return v.line===3;if(c.profile==='c5'||c.profile==='d4')return true;return !!v.portAccess}
function pgCoreKind(v){return v.c2&&v.c2.profile==='bus'?'bus':'core'}
// ---- Road Core v2 hooks --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the junction grant across an arm (grant-in: out of the approach lane; grant-out: into the exit lane) needs the arm open for v
function pgBarrierFor2(v,mv){
 if(!PG_STATE.ready)return null;
 for(const a of PG_STATE.arms){if(a.type==='grant-in'?a.laneSet.has(mv.from.id):a.type==='grant-out'?a.laneSet.has(mv.to.id):false){if(!(a.state==='OPEN'&&a.holder===v.id))return a}}
 return null}
// a 'hold' arm is a virtual stop line: distance from the vehicle centre to where it must stop, or null
function pgHoldDist2(v,lane,nx){
 if(!PG_STATE.ready)return null;const c=v.c2;let best=null;
 for(const a of PG_STATE.arms){if(a.type!=='hold')continue;if(a.state==='OPEN'&&a.holder===v.id)continue;
  let d=null;const here=a.lineS[lane.id];
  if(here!=null){if(c.s+c.hl>here+1)continue;let stop=here-PG_T.BACK-c.hl;if(nx&&nx.kind==='pass')stop=Math.min(stop,nx.sStart-.5);d=stop-c.s}
  else if(nx&&a.lineS[nx.to.id]!=null){const down=a.lineS[nx.to.id]-PG_T.BACK-c.hl;d=down>=nx.sEnd?(nx.sStart-c.s)+nx.len+(down-nx.sEnd):nx.sStart-c.s-.5}
  else continue;
  if(best==null||d<best)best=d}
 return best}
// a public vehicle never chooses a port lane; one that stands on a port lane takes the move that leads out fastest
function pgPublicExitMove(v,lane){const H=PG_STATE.exitHops;if(!H)return null;let best=null,bh=Infinity;for(const m of lane.moves){if(m.kind==='uturn'&&lane.moves.length>1)continue;const h=H.get(m.to.id);if(h!=null&&h<bh){bh=h;best=m}}return best}
// ---- sensors -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function pgSigned(a,x,y){return (x-a.p0[0])*a.n[0]+(y-a.p0[1])*a.n[1]}
function pgAlong(a,x,y){return (x-a.p0[0])*a.ux+(y-a.p0[1])*a.uy}
// a body straddles the arm line inside the arm span: the arm would hit it if it came down
function pgStraddles(a,sh,pad=0){
 // the body (a capsule) under the arm: along its axis, where a circle of the capsule cuts the arm line, the chord must reach the arm span
 const r=sh.radius+pad,N=Math.max(4,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(sh.bx-sh.ax,sh.by-sh.ay)/(sh.radius*.5)));
 for(let k=0;k<=N;k++){const x=sh.ax+(sh.bx-sh.ax)*k/N,y=sh.ay+(sh.by-sh.ay)*k/N,sd=pgSigned(a,x,y);if(Math.abs(sd)>=r)continue;const half=Math.sqrt(r*r-sd*sd),t=pgAlong(a,x,y);if(t+half>0&&t-half<a.len)return true}
 return false}
// path distance from the nose of a road-core vehicle to the arm line, or null when its path does not cross the arm soon
function pgCoreDist(v,a){
 const c=v.c2;if(!c||!c.lane&&!c.mv)return null;
 if(a.type==='grant-in'){if(c.mv){const L=a.lineS[c.mv.to.id];return L!=null?Math.max(0,c.mv.len-c.ms)+(L-c.mv.sEnd)-c.hl:null}
  if(a.laneSet.has(c.lane.id)){const L=a.lineS[c.lane.id];if(L==null)return null;const d=L-c.s-c.hl;return d>=-1?Math.max(0,d):null}
  if(c.gate&&a.laneSet.has(c.gate.lane.id))return Math.max(0,c.gateDist)+PG_T.BACK;return null}
 if(a.type==='grant-out'){if(c.mv&&a.laneSet.has(c.mv.to.id))return 0;if(!c.mv&&c.gate&&a.laneSet.has(c.gate.mv.to.id))return Math.max(0,c.gateDist)+PG_T.BACK;return null}
 if(c.mv){const L=a.lineS[c.mv.to.id];return L!=null?Math.max(0,c.mv.len-c.ms)+(L-c.mv.sEnd)-c.hl:null}
 const here=a.lineS[c.lane.id];if(here!=null){const d=here-c.s-c.hl;return d>=-1?Math.max(0,d):null}
 const nx=c.next;if(nx&&a.lineS[nx.to.id]!=null)return (nx.sStart-c.s)+nx.len+(a.lineS[nx.to.id]-nx.sEnd)-c.hl;
 return null}
// port container trucks: where each route crosses each arm (arclength range), computed once per route
function pgRouteX(R){
 if(R.pgX)return R.pgX;const X=[];
 for(const a of PG_STATE.arms){let s0=null,s1=null;
  for(let i=0;i<R.n;i++){const h=R.h[i],far=Math.abs(R.x[i]-a.mx)>140||Math.abs(R.y[i]-a.my)>140;if(far){if(s0!=null){X.push({a,s0,s1});s0=s1=null}continue}   // any contact counts: a long rigid semi swings across the next arm when it turns at the mouth
   const hit=pgStraddles(a,vehicleCollisionShape('LV-SM-01','SemiLong',R.x[i],R.y[i],h),PG_T.ENV);
   if(hit){if(s0==null)s0=R.s[i];s1=R.s[i]}else if(s0!=null&&R.s[i]-s1>40){X.push({a,s0,s1});s0=s1=null}}
  if(s0!=null)X.push({a,s0,s1})}
 R.pgX=X;return X}
function pgFlCands(out){
 const t=PG_STATE.flNow;
 for(const tr of PG_STATE.flNear){const X=pgRouteX(tr.R);if(!X.length)continue;const tau=t-tr.t0,s=tau<=0?0:flRouteS(tr.R,tau,tr.dw);
  for(const x of X){if(s>x.s1+2)continue;if(x.s0-s>340)continue;let eta=null;
   if(tau>=0&&s>=x.s0)eta=0;else for(let k=.25;k<=PG_T.FL_T+1e-6;k+=.25){const ss=tau+k<=0?0:flRouteS(tr.R,tau+k,tr.dw);if(ss>=x.s0){eta=k;break}}
   if(eta!=null)(out.get(x.a)||out.set(x.a,[]).get(x.a)).push({id:tr.id,kind:'fl',auth:true,eta,dist:eta*40})}}}
function pgPlayerCand(a){
 if(PlayerProfile.mode!=='vehicle'||PlayerCar.x<-9000)return null;const P=PlayerCar,sh=trafficVehicleShape({asset:P.asset,ref:P.ref||'Sedan',x:P.x,y:P.y,heading:P.heading});
 const along=pgSigned(a,P.x,P.y),lat=pgAlong(a,P.x,P.y);if(lat<-12||lat>a.len+12)return null;
 const dirSign=Math.abs(P.speed||0)>1?Math.sign(P.speed):1,toward=(Math.cos(P.heading)*a.n[0]+Math.sin(P.heading)*a.n[1])*dirSign;
 const nose=Math.max(pgSigned(a,sh.ax,sh.ay),pgSigned(a,sh.bx,sh.by))+sh.radius,tail=Math.min(pgSigned(a,sh.ax,sh.ay),pgSigned(a,sh.bx,sh.by))-sh.radius;
 if(tail>.5)return null;   // beyond the line
 if(Math.abs(P.speed||0)<2&&nose<-40)return null;   // parked near the gate: no request
 if(nose<-PG_T.DETECT_PLAYER||(nose<-2&&toward<.3))return null;
 return{id:'PLAYER',kind:'player',auth:a.dir==='out'||pgPlayerAuthorized(),dist:Math.max(0,-nose)}}
// bodies that straddle an arm line (vehicles only: road core, port trucks, the player's car, C5 yard trucks)
function pgBodies(){
 const out=[];const near=(x,y)=>PG_STATE.arms.some(a=>Math.abs(x-a.mx)<260&&Math.abs(y-a.my)<260);
 for(const v of roadVehicles2())if(near(v.x,v.y))out.push({id:v.id,sh:trafficVehicleShape(v)});
 for(const f of FL_ACTIVE)if(f.alpha>=.3&&near(f.x,f.y))out.push({id:f.id,sh:trafficVehicleShape(f)});
 for(const v of C5_SIM.fleet)if(v.c5&&v.c5.mode!=='road'&&near(v.x,v.y))out.push({id:v.id,sh:trafficVehicleShape(v)});
 if(PlayerProfile.mode==='vehicle'&&near(PlayerCar.x,PlayerCar.y))out.push({id:'PLAYER',sh:trafficVehicleShape({asset:PlayerCar.asset,ref:PlayerCar.ref||'Sedan',x:PlayerCar.x,y:PlayerCar.y,heading:PlayerCar.heading})});
 return out}
// ---- the controller (one tick per rendered frame, wall clock like the port trucks; also stepped by the QA harnesses) --------
function pgTick(now){
 if(!PG_STATE.ready){if(!TrafficCore2.ready)return;pgInit()}
 // the port trucks run on the wall clock: after a jump (first tick, a hidden tab, a load, a long hitch) a truck may already stand at
 // or under an arm — such an arm is set straight to OPEN for it (it cannot have been closed on the truck)
 const first=PG_STATE.last==null,raw=first?0:(now-PG_STATE.last)/1000;PG_STATE.last=now;PG_STATE.frames++;if(!first&&raw<=0)return;
 const dt=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,raw)),jump=first||raw>.5;   // the port trucks' clock is not clamped (up to 1 s): neither are the arms
 const cands=new Map();pgFlCands(cands);
 const vs=roadVehicles2();
 for(const a of PG_STATE.arms){const L=cands.get(a)||[];cands.set(a,L);
  for(const v of vs){if(Math.abs(v.x-a.mx)>420||Math.abs(v.y-a.my)>420)continue;const d=pgCoreDist(v,a);if(d==null||d>PG_T.DETECT)continue;L.push({id:v.id,kind:pgCoreKind(v),auth:a.dir==='out'||pgCoreAuthorized(v),dist:d,v})}
  const pc=pgPlayerCand(a);if(pc)L.push(pc)}
 const bodies=pgBodies();
 for(const a of PG_STATE.arms){
  const L=cands.get(a).sort((p,q)=>(p.kind==='fl'?0:1)-(q.kind==='fl'?0:1)||(p.kind==='fl'?p.eta-q.eta:p.dist-q.dist));
  const auth=L.filter(c=>c.auth),env=new Set(bodies.filter(b=>pgStraddles(a,b.sh)).map(b=>b.id));
  const holderC=a.holder?L.find(c=>c.id===a.holder):null,holderHere=!!holderC||env.has(a.holder);
  for(const c of L)if(!c.auth&&c.kind==='player'&&c.dist<70){a.stats.denied++;pgDenyToast(a)}
  // safety net for a port truck the arm can no longer open for in time — after a clock jump (load, hidden tab, long hitch) or a
  // truck whose call was only now generated: the arm goes straight up (never left down on, or in front of, a truck that does not stop)
  if(a.state!=='OPEN'){const need=(a.state==='OPENING'?0:a.state==='CHECKING'&&a.hk==='fl'?Math.max(0,PG_T.CHECK.fl-a.t):PG_T.CHECK.fl)+(1-a.ang)*PG_T.OPEN;
   const late=auth.find(c=>c.kind==='fl'&&(env.has(c.id)||(jump&&c.eta<need-.05)))||(jump?auth.find(c=>env.has(c.id)):null);
   if(late){a.holder=late.id;a.hk=late.kind;a.ang=1;pgSet(a,'OPEN');a.stats.snap=(a.stats.snap||0)+1;pgLog(a,'snap',{who:late.id,jump})}}
  if(a.state==='CLOSED'){a.ang=0;if(auth.length){a.holder=auth[0].id;a.hk=auth[0].kind;pgSet(a,'CHECKING');pgLog(a,'check',{who:a.holder})}else a.holder=null}
  else if(a.state==='CHECKING'){
   const fl=auth.find(c=>c.kind==='fl'&&c.eta<=PG_T.FL_URGENT);if(fl&&a.holder!==fl.id&&!env.has(a.holder)){a.holder=fl.id;a.hk='fl';a.t=Math.min(a.t,PG_T.CHECK.fl*.5)}
   if(!holderHere){if(auth.length){a.holder=auth[0].id;a.hk=auth[0].kind;a.t=0}else{a.holder=null;pgSet(a,a.ang>0?'CLOSING':'CLOSED')}}
   else{a.t+=dt;if(a.t>=(PG_T.CHECK[a.hk]??1)){pgSet(a,a.ang>=1?'OPEN':'OPENING');pgLog(a,'admit',{who:a.holder,kind:a.hk})}}}
  else if(a.state==='OPENING'){a.ang=Math.min(1,a.ang+dt/PG_T.OPEN);if(a.ang>=1)pgSet(a,'OPEN')}
  else if(a.state==='OPEN'){a.ang=1;a.openT+=dt;
   const stale=holderC&&holderC.kind!=='fl'&&holderC.dist>40&&a.openT>PG_T.HOLD_IDLE&&!env.has(a.holder);
   if(!holderHere||stale){if(!stale){a.stats.passes++;a.stats.byKind[a.hk]=(a.stats.byKind[a.hk]||0)+1;pgLog(a,'pass',{who:a.holder,kind:a.hk})}
    const next=auth.find(c=>c.id!==a.holder);if(next){a.holder=next.id;a.hk=next.kind;pgSet(a,'CHECKING')}else{a.holder=null;pgSet(a,'CLOSING')}}}
  else if(a.state==='CLOSING'){
   if(env.size){a.stats.reopen++;pgLog(a,'reopen',{who:[...env][0]});pgSet(a,'OPENING');const c=auth.find(q=>env.has(q.id));if(c){a.holder=c.id;a.hk=c.kind}}
   else{a.ang=Math.max(0,a.ang-dt/PG_T.CLOSE);if(a.ang<=0){pgSet(a,'CLOSED');a.holder=null}}}
  // safety statistics for QA: a port truck that reaches the line before the arm is fully up
  for(const id of env){if(a.ang<.98){a.stats.lowOnBody=(a.stats.lowOnBody||0)+1;if(/^FL-/.test(id))a.stats.flOpenLate++;if((a.stats.lowIds||(a.stats.lowIds=[])).length<6)a.stats.lowIds.push(id+'@'+a.state)}}
 }
}
function pgDenyToast(a){if(SIM.t-PG_STATE.toastAt<8)return;PG_STATE.toastAt=SIM.t;PG_STATE.stats.denied++;
 try{if(PlayerProfile.mode==='vehicle'||PlayerProfile.mode==='walk')toast(a.gate.label+' · כניסה למורשים בלבד — '+(a.gate.intercom?'היתר כניסה באינטרקום (F)':'השער נפתח רק לרכבי הנמל'))}catch{}}
// ---- the player's walls (car: fence, wickets, booths, arms that are not open for the player; person: fence, every arm, wickets
//      unless authorised or leaving) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function pgArmOpenFor(a,id){return a.state==='OPEN'&&a.ang>=.98&&a.holder===id}
function pgCarWall(x,y,heading){
 if(!PG_STATE.ready)return null;const sh=vehicleCollisionShape(PlayerCar.asset,PlayerCar.ref||'Sedan',x,y,heading),r=sh.radius;
 if(!PG_GATES.some(g=>{const [p,q]=g.line;return Math.abs(x-(p[0]+q[0])/2)<420&&Math.abs(y-(p[1]+q[1])/2)<420})&&!pgNearFence(x,y,420))return null;
 const hitSeg=(p,q,w)=>pgSegDist(sh.ax,sh.ay,sh.bx,sh.by,p[0],p[1],q[0],q[1])<r+w;
 for(const [p,q] of PG_FENCE)if(hitSeg(p,q,1.5))return 'PORT-FENCE';
 for(const g of PG_GATES){for(const [p,q] of g.wickets)if(hitSeg(p,q,1.5))return g.id+':WICKET';
  if(g.booth&&circleRectHit(x,y,r,{x:g.booth[0]-13,y:g.booth[1]-10,w:26,h:20}))return g.id+':BOOTH';
  for(const a of g.arms){if(pgArmOpenFor(a,'PLAYER'))continue;if(!hitSeg(a.p0,a.p1,1.5))continue;
   // a car that already straddles the line (stopped under a raised arm) may always move away from it
   const da=pgSigned(a,sh.ax,sh.ay),db=pgSigned(a,sh.bx,sh.by),P0=pgSigned(a,PlayerCar.x,PlayerCar.y),P1=pgSigned(a,x,y);
   if(Math.min(da,db)-r<-.5&&Math.max(da,db)+r>.5&&Math.abs(P1)>Math.abs(P0))continue;
   return a.id}}
 return null}
function pgNearFence(x,y,m){return PG_FENCE.some(([p,q])=>x>Math.min(p[0],q[0])-m&&x<Math.max(p[0],q[0])+m&&y>Math.min(p[1],q[1])-m&&y<Math.max(p[1],q[1])+m)}
function pgPersonWall(x,y,r){
 if(!PG_STATE.ready)return null;if(!pgNearFence(x,y,60)&&!PG_GATES.some(g=>{const [p,q]=g.line;return Math.abs(x-(p[0]+q[0])/2)<160&&Math.abs(y-(p[1]+q[1])/2)<160}))return null;
 const d=(p,q)=>Math.sqrt(pointSegmentDistanceSq(x,y,p[0],p[1],q[0],q[1]));
 for(const [p,q] of PG_FENCE)if(d(p,q)<r+1.5)return 'PORT-FENCE';
 const auth=pgPlayerAuthorized();
 for(const g of PG_GATES){const ain=g.arms.find(a=>a.dir==='in'),out=((x-PlayerPed.x)*ain.n[0]+(y-PlayerPed.y)*ain.n[1])<0,ok=auth||out;   // leaving through a wicket is always allowed

  if(g.booth&&circleRectHit(x,y,r,{x:g.booth[0]-13,y:g.booth[1]-10,w:26,h:20}))return g.id+':BOOTH';
  for(const a of g.arms)if(d(a.p0,a.p1)<r+1.5)return a.id;
  for(const [p,q] of g.wickets)if(d(p,q)<r+1.5){if(ok){g.wicketOpenT=SIM.t;continue}PG_STATE.stats.wicketDenied++;if(SIM.t-PG_STATE.toastAt>8){PG_STATE.toastAt=SIM.t;try{toast(g.label+' · שער הולכי רגל למורשים בלבד — היתר באינטרקום (F)')}catch{}}return g.id+':WICKET'}}
 return null}
// ---- the gate intercom (permit / work pass) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function pgNearIntercom(){
 if(!PG_STATE.ready)return null;const walk=PlayerProfile.mode==='walk',p=walk?PlayerPed:PlayerCar;if(!walk&&carKmh()>3)return null;

// ---- Port Access Control: drawing (fence, booths, intercoms, stop bars, the C5 driveway — under the vehicles; arms, signal heads
//      and wickets — over them) ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function pgDraw(layer,now){
 if(!PG_STATE.ready)return;const v=portView(120);
 ctx.save();
 if(layer==='base'){
  // C5 delivery driveway to the C6 receiver bay (asphalt across the sidewalk and the tree strip, painted bay)
  {const d=C5_PORT_DRIVE,b=C5_BAY;if(false&&portVis(v,d.x-10,d.y-10,d.w+20,d.h+20)){ctx.fillStyle='#4a4f55';ctx.fillRect(d.x,d.y,d.w,b.y-d.y);ctx.fillStyle='#55595f';ctx.fillRect(b.x-4,b.y,b.w+8,b.h);
   ctx.strokeStyle='#f0c43a';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(b.x+1,b.y+2,b.w-2,b.h-6);ctx.setLineDash([6,5]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(b.x+1,b.y+b.h-14);ctx.lineTo(b.x+b.w-1,b.y+b.h-14);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
   ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.55)';ctx.lineWidth=1.2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(d.x+.5,d.y+2);ctx.lineTo(d.x+.5,b.y);ctx.moveTo(d.x+d.w-.5,d.y+2);ctx.lineTo(d.x+d.w-.5,b.y);ctx.stroke();
   e3Text('פריקה',b.x+b.w/2,b.y+b.h-30,9,'#f0c43a',0,800)}}
  // fence (chain link: shadow, wire, posts)
  for(const [p,q] of PG_FENCE){const x=Math.min(p[0],q[0]),y=Math.min(p[1],q[1]);if(!portVis(v,x-6,y-6,Math.abs(q[0]-p[0])+12,Math.abs(q[1]-p[1])+12))continue;
   ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.22)';ctx.lineWidth=2.2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p[0]+2,p[1]+3);ctx.lineTo(q[0]+2,q[1]+3);ctx.stroke();

   const len=Math.hypot(q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]),n=Math.max(1,Math.round(len/26));ctx.fillStyle='#38434a';for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const px=p[0]+(q[0]-p[0])*i/n,py=p[1]+(q[1]-p[1])*i/n;if(portVis(v,px-3,py-3,6,6))ctx.fillRect(px-1.7,py-1.7,3.4,3.4)}}
  for(const g of PG_GATES){const [p,q]=g.line;if(!portVis(v,Math.min(p[0],q[0])-80,Math.min(p[1],q[1])-80,Math.abs(q[0]-p[0])+160,Math.abs(q[1]-p[1])+160))continue;
   // stop bar on the approach side of every arm
   for(const a of g.arms){const ox=-a.n[0]*PG_T.BACK,oy=-a.n[1]*PG_T.BACK;ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(245,245,240,.82)';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.p0[0]+ox+a.ux*2,a.p0[1]+oy+a.uy*2);ctx.lineTo(a.p1[0]+ox-a.ux*1,a.p1[1]+oy-a.uy*1);ctx.stroke()}
   if(g.booth){const [bx,by]=g.booth;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.25)';ctx.fillRect(bx-11,by-7,26,20);ctx.fillStyle='#dfe4e8';ctx.fillRect(bx-13,by-10,26,20);ctx.fillStyle='#3a6b8c';ctx.fillRect(bx-13,by-10,26,6);ctx.fillStyle='#9fc7df';ctx.fillRect(bx-10,by-2,20,5);ctx.strokeStyle='#2c3a44';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.strokeRect(bx-12.5,by-9.5,25,19);e3Text('שער',bx,by+6.5,6.5,'#24323b',0,800)}
   if(g.intercom){const [ix,iy]=g.intercom;ctx.fillStyle='#2c3a44';ctx.fillRect(ix-2.5,iy-2.5,5,5);ctx.fillStyle='#4fb3e8';ctx.fillRect(ix-1.5,iy-1.5,3,2)}
   if(g.sign)e4Plate(g.sign[2]<100?'נמל · למורשים בלבד':'נמל · כניסה למורשים בלבד',g.sign[0],g.sign[1],g.sign[2]||112)}
 }else{
  for(const g of PG_GATES){const [p,q]=g.line;if(!portVis(v,Math.min(p[0],q[0])-60,Math.min(p[1],q[1])-60,Math.abs(q[0]-p[0])+120,Math.abs(q[1]-p[1])+120))continue;
   for(const a of g.arms){
    const L=a.len*Math.cos(a.ang*Math.PI/2),lift=Math.sin(a.ang*Math.PI/2);
    // boom (foreshortened while it lifts) with its shadow, red / white bands
    if(L>1.5){ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.24)';ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.p0[0]+2+lift*3,a.p0[1]+3+lift*3);ctx.lineTo(a.p0[0]+a.ux*L+2+lift*6,a.p0[1]+a.uy*L+3+lift*6);ctx.stroke();
     const seg=8,nS=Math.ceil(L/seg);ctx.lineWidth=3.4;for(let i=0;i<nS;i++){const s0=i*seg,s1=Math.min(L,(i+1)*seg);ctx.strokeStyle=i%2?'#f4f4f0':'#d23b33';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.p0[0]+a.ux*s0,a.p0[1]+a.uy*s0);ctx.lineTo(a.p0[0]+a.ux*s1,a.p0[1]+a.uy*s1);ctx.stroke()}
     ctx.fillStyle='#d23b33';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(a.p0[0]+a.ux*L,a.p0[1]+a.uy*L,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
    else{ctx.fillStyle='#d23b33';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(a.p0[0],a.p0[1],3.2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
    // pivot housing + signal head
    ctx.fillStyle='#2c3a44';ctx.fillRect(a.p0[0]-4.5,a.p0[1]-4.5,9,9);ctx.fillStyle='#e0b93a';ctx.fillRect(a.p0[0]-3,a.p0[1]-3,6,6);
    const hx=a.p0[0]-a.n[0]*9-a.ux*3,hy=a.p0[1]-a.n[1]*9-a.uy*3,col=a.state==='OPEN'?'#37d27a':a.state==='CHECKING'||a.state==='OPENING'?'#f2b233':'#e8433a';
    ctx.fillStyle='#1d262c';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(hx,hy,3.6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(hx,hy,2.4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
   // pedestrian wickets: a leaf that swings open for an authorised person
   for(const [p0,p1] of g.wickets){const open=g.wicketOpenT!=null&&SIM.t-g.wicketOpenT<1.6,L=Math.hypot(p1[0]-p0[0],p1[1]-p0[1]),ang=Math.atan2(p1[1]-p0[1],p1[0]-p0[0])+(open?1.25:0);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#38434a';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p0[0],p0[1]);ctx.lineTo(p0[0]+Math.cos(ang)*(L-2),p0[1]+Math.sin(ang)*(L-2));ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='#38434a';ctx.fillRect(p0[0]-2,p0[1]-2,4,4);ctx.fillRect(p1[0]-2,p1[1]-2,4,4)}}
 }
 ctx.restore()}
// ---- Port Access Control: audits + QA (PORT-03 / PORT-04) -----------------------------------------------------------------
function pgStructureAudit(){
 pgInit();const issues=[],R=[];
 const plans=[]   /* S11: PORT-B6-N / -S יצאו */,   /* S10 א: ארבעת השערים של C6 / D6 יצאו */gates=PG_GATES.filter(g=>g.kind==='gate'),chk=PG_GATES.filter(g=>g.kind==='checkpoint');   /* S9 · S7F268: PORT-NORTH-D5 and PORT-NORTH-E5 are out with E5's old roads; the E6 checkpoint is on the boundary */
 for(const p of plans)if(!gates.some(g=>g.plan===p))issues.push('missing gate '+p);
 if(gates.length!==0||chk.length!==1)   /* int287: PG-CHK-E6 יוצא עם E6-IN ב-021s (S10 ב) — נשאר PG-CHK-Q4 */issues.push(`gates ${gates.length} / checkpoints ${chk.length}`);
 // every lane of the gate road crosses the gate line inside the arm of its own direction (state machine per direction)
 let lanesChecked=0;
 for(const g of PG_GATES){const e=byEdge[g.road];if(!e){issues.push(g.id+': road '+g.road);continue}
  if(g.arms.length!==2||!g.arms.some(a=>a.dir==='in')||!g.arms.some(a=>a.dir==='out'))issues.push(g.id+': arms');
  for(const l of LANE_LIST2.filter(l=>l.edge===g.road)){const [p,q]=g.line,dx=q[0]-p[0],dy=q[1]-p[1],den=l.ux*dy-l.uy*dx;if(Math.abs(den)<1e-6){issues.push(g.id+': lane parallel '+l.id);continue}
   const t=((p[0]-l.ax)*dy-(p[1]-l.ay)*dx)/den,cx=l.ax+l.ux*t,cy=l.ay+l.uy*t;
   const a=g.arms.find(a=>l.ux*a.n[0]+l.uy*a.n[1]>.7);if(!a){issues.push(g.id+': no arm for '+l.id);continue}
   const at=pgAlong(a,cx,cy);if(at<8||at>a.len-8)issues.push(`${g.id}: lane ${l.id} crosses at ${at.toFixed(0)} of ${a.len.toFixed(0)}`);lanesChecked++}}
 // the gate line + fence + wickets close the envelope: every point of its boundary is fence, a gate line, the world edge, the sea
 // or the fenced rail corridor
 const near=(x,y,[p,q],m)=>pointSegmentDistanceSq(x,y,p[0],p[1],q[0],q[1])<=m*m;
 const gaps=[];
 for(let i=0;i<PG_ZONE.length;i++){const [p,q]=[PG_ZONE[i],PG_ZONE[(i+1)%PG_ZONE.length]],L=Math.hypot(q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]);
  for(let s=0;s<=L;s+=4){const x=p[0]+(q[0]-p[0])*s/L,y=p[1]+(q[1]-p[1])*s/L;
   if(x>=5999||y>=5059||(Math.abs(y-4300)<=1&&x>5729&&x<5941))continue;   // world edge · sea · rail corridor (the yard spur, mains A and B — the E5 / E6 rail fences; S9 · S7F268)
   if(PG_FENCE.some(f=>near(x,y,f,2.5))||PG_GATES.some(g=>near(x,y,g.line,2.5)))continue;
   if(gaps.length<6)gaps.push(Math.round(x)+','+Math.round(y))}}
 if(gaps.length)issues.push('boundary gaps '+gaps.join(' '));
 // the rail corridor is closed for a person (E4 / E5 rail fences) and the sea is not walkable
 for(const x of [5750,5800,5850,5900,5920])if(!personBlockedAt(x,4300,5))issues.push('rail corridor open at '+x);   /* S9 · S7F268: the corridor at the envelope's north edge (y 4300) */
 // every road that crosses the envelope boundary crosses it at a gate line (sampled every 4 px along every road)
 let crossings=0;const crossedAt=new Set();
 for(const e of EDGES){const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],L=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y),n=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(L/4));let prev=inPortZone(a.x,a.y);
  for(let k=1;k<=n;k++){const x=a.x+(b.x-a.x)*k/n,y=a.y+(b.y-a.y)*k/n,cur=inPortZone(x,y);if(cur===prev)continue;prev=cur;
   const mx=x-(b.x-a.x)/n/2,my=y-(b.y-a.y)/n/2;if(mx>=5999||my>=5059)continue;crossings++;
   const g=PG_GATES.find(g=>(g.kind==='gate'||g.boundary)&&near(mx,my,g.line,6));if(g)crossedAt.add(g.id);else issues.push(`road ${e.id} crosses the boundary at ${Math.round(mx)},${Math.round(my)} without a gate`)}}
 if(crossedAt.size!==1)issues.push('roads cross the boundary at '+crossedAt.size+' gates');   /* int287: רק דרך הרציף ב-PG-CHK-Q4 (E6-IN יצא, S10 ב) */   /* S11: שערי B6 יצאו · S10 א: ארבעת השערים יצאו, המחסום PG-CHK-Q4 נכנס (2) */   /* S9 · S7F268: 4 gates and the E6 checkpoint on the boundary */
 // access class: every lane inside (and every approach lane) is 'port' and not public; the public network does not lead inside
 let acc=0;for(const l of LANE_LIST2){const mid=lanePose2(l,l.len/2),inside=inPortZone(mid.x,mid.y);if(l.acc){acc++;if(l.public)issues.push('public port lane '+l.id)}else if(inside)issues.push('lane inside without access class '+l.id)}
 for(const id of PG_APPROACH)for(const l of LANE_LIST2.filter(l=>l.edge===id))if(!l.acc)issues.push('approach without access class '+l.id);
 let pubLanes=0;for(const l of LANE_LIST2){if(!l.public)continue;pubLanes++;if(l.ptNext&&l.ptNext.to.acc)issues.push('public lane passes into the port '+l.id+'>'+l.ptNext.to.id);
  if(!l.moves.some(m=>m.to.public))issues.push('public lane without a public exit '+l.id)}
 for(const id of TRAFFIC_SEED_EDGES){const e=byEdge[id];if(!e||pgRestrictedEdge(e)||!trafficPublicEdge(e))issues.push('seed edge '+id)}
 const taxiIn=taxiDestinationPoisAll().filter(p=>inPortZone(p.x,p.y)).length;if(taxiIn)issues.push('taxi destinations inside '+taxiIn);
 // intercoms stand outside, reachable on foot; wickets sit on the boundary
 for(const g of PG_GATES){if(g.intercom){const [x,y]=g.intercom;if(inPortZone(x,y))issues.push(g.id+': intercom inside');}
  for(const [p,q] of g.wickets)if(!near((p[0]+q[0])/2,(p[1]+q[1])/2,g.line,1))issues.push(g.id+': wicket off the gate line')}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,20),gates:gates.length,checkpoints:chk.length,arms:PG_STATE.arms.length,lanesChecked,boundaryRoads:crossings,gatesCrossed:crossedAt.size,portLanes:acc,publicLanes:pubLanes,restrictedEdges:PG_RESTRICTED_IDS.size,fenceSegments:PG_FENCE.length}}
function taxiDestinationPoisAll(){const save=PlayerPed.x,saveY=PlayerPed.y;PlayerPed.x=-99999;PlayerPed.y=-99999;try{return taxiDestinationPois()}finally{PlayerPed.x=save;PlayerPed.y=saveY}}
// who is authorised, and which arms each authorised fleet actually uses
function pgAuthAudit(){
 pgInit();const issues=[],use={};
 const crosses=(edges)=>{const out=new Set();for(const a of PG_STATE.arms)for(const seg of edges){const l=lane2(seg.edgeId,seg.dirSign,0);if(!l)continue;if(a.laneSet.has(l.id)||a.armLane===l)out.add(a.id)}return [...out]};
 use.bus3=crosses(busRouteForLine(3));   /* S9 · S7F268: קו 3 כבר לא נכנס לנמל (PG-D5-N יצא) — אף קו לא עובר בשער */
 for(const l of [1,2,3,4]){const u=crosses(busRouteForLine(l));if(u.length)issues.push('line '+l+' crosses '+u.join(','))}
 use.c5=[...crosses(C5_ROUTE_LOAD),...crosses(C5_ROUTE_HOME)];if(use.c5.length)issues.push('C5 road routes cross '+use.c5.join(','));
 if([...C5_ROUTE_LOAD,...C5_ROUTE_HOME].some(s=>pgRestrictedEdge(byEdge[s.edgeId])))issues.push('C5 road route on a port lane');
 use.d4=crosses(D4_CITY_TRUCK_ROUTE);if(use.d4.length)issues.push('D4 route crosses '+use.d4.join(','));
 // port container trucks: every route crosses only the C6 gate / the E6 checkpoint, both ways
 const fl={};for(const key of Object.keys(FL_SPEC)){const X=pgRouteX(flRoute(key));fl[key]=X.map(x=>x.a.id);const want=FL_SPEC[key].berth==='C6'?['PG-C6-N:in','PG-C6-N:out']:['PG-CHK-E6:in','PG-CHK-E6:out'];
  if(want.some(w=>!fl[key].includes(w))||fl[key].some(id=>!want.includes(id)))issues.push('FL '+key+' crosses '+fl[key].join(','))}
 use.fl=[...new Set(Object.values(fl).flat())];
 // the player: no access without a permit / port mission / work pass; the permit opens; leaving is always allowed
 const certs=ensureActivitySchema().certs,had=certs['PORT-PASS'],am=PlayerProfile.activeMission,wp=State.pgWorkPass;
 try{delete certs['PORT-PASS'];PlayerProfile.activeMission=null;State.pgWorkPass=null;if(pgPlayerAuthorized())issues.push('player authorised without permit');
  certs['PORT-PASS']={at:'qa'};if(!pgPlayerAuthorized())issues.push('permit does not authorise');delete certs['PORT-PASS'];
  PlayerProfile.activeMission={id:Object.keys(MISSION_DEFS).find(id=>pgMissionTouches(id))||'M-D5-01'};if(!pgPlayerAuthorized())issues.push('port mission does not authorise');   /* S9 · S7F268: M-D5-01 (E5 → D5) no longer enters the port — any mission into the port */PlayerProfile.activeMission={id:'M-C4-01'};if(pgPlayerAuthorized())issues.push('a city mission authorises');
  PlayerProfile.activeMission=null;State.pgWorkPass={until:SIM.t+60};if(!pgPlayerAuthorized())issues.push('work pass does not authorise')}
 finally{if(had)certs['PORT-PASS']=had;else delete certs['PORT-PASS'];PlayerProfile.activeMission=am;State.pgWorkPass=wp}
 const pm=Object.values(MISSION_DEFS).filter(d=>pgMissionTouches(d.id)).map(d=>d.id);
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,16),use,portMissions:pm.length,flRoutes:Object.keys(fl).length}}
// sampled in the QA-44 harness: public vehicles in the port, port trucks overlapping any other vehicle
function pgQaSample(){
 const out={pub:0,pubIds:[],flOver:0,flOverIds:[]};const rows=trafficRoadActors();
 for(const r of rows){const v=r.v;if(pgCoreAuthorized(v))continue;if(inPortZone(v.x,v.y)||(v.c2&&v.c2.lane&&v.c2.lane.acc)){out.pub++;if(out.pubIds.length<4)out.pubIds.push(v.id+'@'+(v.edgeId||'?'))}}
 const others=[...rows.map(r=>r.v),...C5_SIM.fleet.filter(v=>v.c5&&v.c5.mode!=='road')];
 for(const f of FL_ACTIVE){if(!(f.alpha>=.3))continue;const fs=trafficVehicleShape(f);for(const o of others){if(Math.abs(o.x-f.x)>170||Math.abs(o.y-f.y)>170)continue;if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(fs,trafficVehicleShape(o),0)){out.flOver++;if(out.flOverIds.length<4)out.flOverIds.push(f.id+'/'+o.id)}}}
 return out}
function pgQaTotals(){if(!PG_STATE.ready&&TrafficCore2.ready)pgInit();const t={opens:0,passes:0,reopen:0,flOpenLate:0,lowOnBody:0,snap:0,byGate:{}};

  const g=t.byGate[a.id]=t.byGate[a.id]||{};for(const [k,n] of Object.entries(a.stats.byKind))g[k]=n}

function pgQaDiff(a,b){const d={opens:b.opens-a.opens,passes:b.passes-a.passes,reopen:b.reopen-a.reopen,flOpenLate:b.flOpenLate-a.flOpenLate,lowOnBody:b.lowOnBody-a.lowOnBody,snap:(b.snap||0)-(a.snap||0),byGate:{}};
 for(const [id,g] of Object.entries(b.byGate)){const o={};for(const [k,n] of Object.entries(g)){const v=n-((a.byGate[id]||{})[k]||0);if(v)o[k]=v}if(Object.keys(o).length)d.byGate[id]=o}return d}
// the C5 receiver bay: reached by the trucks' own driveway, outside the port, clear of every static obstacle
function pgC5Audit(){const issues=[];const path=c5PortCross(),v={id:'C5-QA',asset:'VH-TR-01',ref:'Truck'};
 for(let i=0;i<=30;i++){const p=c5PathPose(path,path.total*i/30),sh=trafficVehicleShape({...v,...p});for(const [x,y] of [[p.x,p.y],[sh.ax,sh.ay],[sh.bx,sh.by]]){const hit=blockedAt(x,y,sh.radius);if(hit){issues.push('crossing blocked by '+hit+' at '+Math.round(p.y));break}}if(issues.length)break}

// functional QA: the player's car and person at every gate, and road-core vehicles through every arm
window.__TC_G75S4_QA=(opts={})=>{

 const certs=ensureActivitySchema().certs,snap={car:{x:PlayerCar.x,y:PlayerCar.y,heading:PlayerCar.heading,speed:PlayerCar.speed,collisions:PlayerCar.collisions},mode:PlayerProfile.mode,ped:{x:PlayerPed.x,y:PlayerPed.y,heading:PlayerPed.heading},eco:cloneJson(activeVehicleEco()),pass:certs['PORT-PASS']||null,am:PlayerProfile.activeMission,wp:State.pgWorkPass,money:PlayerProfile.money,toast:typeof window.toast};

 try{
  FL_ACTIVE.length=0;PG_STATE.flNear.length=0;
  // 1) the player's car
  for(const g of PG_GATES)for(const a of g.arms)for(const permit of (a.dir==='in'?[false,true]:[false])){
   resetArms();setAccess(permit);PlayerProfile.mode='vehicle';PlayerPed.x=-9500;PlayerPed.y=-9500;
   const cx=a.p0[0]+a.ux*a.len*.5,cy=a.p0[1]+a.uy*a.len*.5,back=84;PlayerCar.x=cx-a.n[0]*back;PlayerCar.y=cy-a.n[1]*back;PlayerCar.heading=Math.atan2(a.n[1],a.n[0]);PlayerCar.speed=0;
   activeVehicleEco().fuel=100;activeVehicleEco().damage=0;const col0=PlayerCar.collisions,expect=a.dir==='out'||permit;const seq=[];let crossed=false,maxNose=-999,clearAt=null,heldBy=false;
   for(let i=0;i<260;i++){const sh=trafficVehicleShape({asset:PlayerCar.asset,ref:PlayerCar.ref||'Sedan',x:PlayerCar.x,y:PlayerCar.y,heading:PlayerCar.heading}),ds=[pgSigned(a,sh.ax,sh.ay),pgSigned(a,sh.bx,sh.by)],nose=Math.max(...ds)+sh.radius,tail=Math.min(...ds)-sh.radius;
    maxNose=Math.max(maxNose,nose);if(tail>3&&!crossed){crossed=true;clearAt=i}
    Input.held.clear();if(crossed&&i-clearAt>12)Input.held.add('Space');else if(!expect||pgArmOpenFor(a,'PLAYER')||nose<-18||crossed)Input.held.add('KeyW');else Input.held.add('Space');
    updateCar(.05);tickPg(.05);if(seq[seq.length-1]!==a.state)seq.push(a.state);if(a.holder==='PLAYER')heldBy=true;if(crossed&&a.state==='CLOSED'&&i-clearAt>20)break}
   Input.held.clear();const s=seq.join('>');
   const ok=expect?crossed&&/CHECKING.*OPEN.*CLOSING.*CLOSED/.test(s):!crossed&&maxNose<=1.5&&!heldBy;
   res.player.push({arm:a.id,permit,expect,ok,crossed,maxNose:+maxNose.toFixed(1),seq:s,hits:PlayerCar.collisions-col0})}

function trafficPublicEdge(e){return !!e&&!pgRestrictedEdge(e)&&!e.future&&!e.freightOnly&&!e.serviceOnly&&(!flPortEdge(e)||(/^TC-(E2|F2|G2)-/.test(e.globalRoadId||'')&&['R-AIR','R-AIR-E'].includes(e.corridor)))}
// Half-width of the crossing carriageway at a junction as seen from the entering road (collinear continuations do not count).
function trafficBoxHalf(nodeId,edgeInId){
 const e=byEdge[edgeInId],a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],hx=b.x-a.x,hy=b.y-a.y,hl=Math.hypot(hx,hy)||1;let half=0;
 for(const q of trafficIncident(nodeId)){if(q.id===edgeInId)continue;const qa=byNode[q.a],qb=byNode[q.b],qx=qb.x-qa.x,qy=qb.y-qa.y,ql=Math.hypot(qx,qy)||1,c=Math.abs((hx*qx+hy*qy)/(hl*ql));if(c>.94)continue;half=Math.max(half,TYPES[q.cls].width/2)}
 return half
}
function trafficReseed(seed=777){

 TRAFFIC_JUNCTION_LOCKS.clear();
 TRAFFIC_CARS.forEach((car,i)=>{if(car.c5||car.taxiRoute||!/^AI-CAR-/.test(car.id))return;const lap=Math.floor(i/TRAFFIC_SEED_EDGES.length),edgeId=TRAFFIC_SEED_SLOTS[i]||car.edgeId,e=byEdge[edgeId];if(!e)return;
  const dirSign=rnd()<.5?1:-1,t=lap===0?.14+rnd()*.34:.58+rnd()*.24,lane=e.cls==='main'?(car.lanePref3??i%3):e.cls==='arterial'?(car.lanePref??i%2):0,p=trafficEdgePoint(edgeId,dirSign,t,lane);
  Object.assign(car,{edgeId,dirSign,t,lane,laneTarget:lane,x:p.x,y:p.y,heading:p.heading,speed:0,wait:false,hop:i+Math.floor(rnd()*7),stuck:0,ghost:0,plan:null,ptPlan:null,turn:null,runKey:null,junctionLock:null,junctionTicket:null,junctionLockNext:null,junctionTicketNext:null,plan2:null,recoveryBoost:0,deadlockRelease:0,hardEpisodes:0,queueWatchdogs:0,backouts:0,commitCooldown:0,hardEvent:false,stuckEvent:false})});
 for(const b of BUS_VEHICLES){b.deadlockRelease=0;b.recoveries=0;b.freezeRecoveries=0;b.hardEpisodes=0;b.queueWatchdogs=0;b.backouts=0}
 for(const v of (typeof D4_YARD_SEMIS==='undefined'?[]:D4_YARD_SEMIS)){v.deadlockRelease=0;v.recoveries=0;v.hardEpisodes=0;v.backouts=0}
 separateInitialTraffic();
 return{seed,cars:TRAFFIC_CARS.length}
}
// Road actors for QA: everything that drives on the graph right now.
function trafficRoadActors(){
 const out=[];
 for(const c of TRAFFIC_CARS){if(c.c5&&c.c5.mode!=='road')continue;out.push({v:c,kind:'car'})}
 for(const b of BUS_VEHICLES)out.push({v:b,kind:'bus'});
 for(const s of (typeof D4_YARD_SEMIS==='undefined'?[]:D4_YARD_SEMIS))if(s.k==='road')out.push({v:s,kind:'semi'});
 return out
}
function trafficLegitStop(r){const v=r.v;if(r.kind==='bus')return !!(v.term||v.dwell>0||v.airport4);if(r.kind==='car')return !!(v.taxiRoute?.hold);return false}
function trafficReleaseTotal(){let n=0;for(const r of trafficRoadActors())n+=(r.v.deadlockRelease||0)+(r.v.backouts||0);return n}
// Live traffic health snapshot (also used by the phone / debug reporter): frozen = no movement for ≥ windowS seconds without a legitimate reason.
const TRAFFIC_HEALTH={hist:new Map(),t:0,lastSample:-1e9};
function trafficHealthSample(now=performance.now(),windowS=60){
 const t=now/1000;TRAFFIC_HEALTH.t=t;const rows=trafficRoadActors();let frozen=0,legit=0,over=0;const frozenIds=[],overIds=[];
 for(const r of rows){const v=r.v;let h=TRAFFIC_HEALTH.hist.get(v.id);if(!h){h=[];TRAFFIC_HEALTH.hist.set(v.id,h)}h.push([t,v.x,v.y]);while(h.length&&t-h[0][0]>windowS+.01)h.shift();
  if(t-h[0][0]<windowS-.1)continue;let maxd=0;for(const q of h)maxd=Math.max(maxd,Math.hypot(q[1]-v.x,q[2]-v.y));
  if(maxd<4){if(trafficLegitStop(r))legit++;else{frozen++;frozenIds.push(v.id+'@'+(v.edgeId||'?'))}}}
 const sh=rows.map(r=>trafficVehicleShape(r.v));
 for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<rows.length;j++){if(Math.abs(rows[i].v.x-rows[j].v.x)>150||Math.abs(rows[i].v.y-rows[j].v.y)>150)continue;if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(sh[i],sh[j],1.2)){over++;overIds.push(rows[i].v.id+'/'+rows[j].v.id)}}
 let waiting=0,committed=0;for(const r of rows){if(r.v.wait)waiting++;if(r.v.junctionLock)committed++}
 return{t:+t.toFixed(1),actors:rows.length,frozen,frozenLegit:legit,frozenIds:frozenIds.slice(0,24),over,overIds:overIds.slice(0,8),waiting,committed,releases:trafficReleaseTotal(),locks:TRAFFIC_JUNCTION_LOCKS.size,passThroughNodes:TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.size}
}
// Static contract audit (World Audits): pass-through set, hold lines outside every box, stop lines outside the box, no legacy in-box hold.
function traffic01Audit(){
 // GATE-75 S3: the TRAFFIC-01 contract stated on Road Core v2 (the previous engine is gone): pass-through nodes are road (no box, no stop
 // line); every lane that ends at a junction stops outside the box, before the crosswalk and before every curve of its movements
 const issues=[];
 const deg2=NODES.filter(n=>trafficIncident(n.id).length===2),expectedPass=deg2.filter(n=>!SIGNALS.some(s=>s.node===n.id)&&!CROSSWALKS.some(c=>c.signalNode===n.id)).length;
 if(TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.size!==expectedPass)issues.push(`pass-through set ${TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.size}≠${expectedPass}`);
 for(const id of TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH)if(SIGNALS.some(s=>s.node===id))issues.push(id+': signalized node marked pass-through');
 for(const id of ['D3N','D3A2','B2S','D2E-AIR','D3E'])if(byNode[id]&&!TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.has(id))issues.push(id+': expected pass-through');
 for(const id of ['D3S','AIR-W0','B3C1','J54_26','J61_26'])if(TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.has(id))issues.push(id+': junction marked pass-through');
 if(!TrafficCore2.ready)issues.push('Road Core v2 not initialised');
 for(const id of TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH){const n=NODES2.get(id);if(!n||!n.pt)issues.push(id+': not a pass-through node in the lane graph')}
 let checked=0;
 for(const lane of LANE_LIST2){const n=NODES2.get(lane.nodeTo);if(!n||n.pt||n.dead)continue;checked++;
  if(lane.stopS>lane.len-lane.boxTo+.01)issues.push(lane.id+': stop line inside the box');
  const cw=CROSSWALKS.find(c=>c.signalNode===lane.nodeTo&&c.roadId===lane.edge);if(cw){const nn=byNode[lane.nodeTo],d=Math.hypot(cw.x-nn.x,cw.y-nn.y);if(lane.len-lane.stopS<d-.01)issues.push(lane.id+': stop line on the crosswalk')}
  for(const m of lane.moves)if(m.sStart<lane.stopS-.01){issues.push(lane.id+': curve starts before the stop line');break}}
 if(!(TRAFFIC_FOLLOW_GAP>=10&&CORE2.BOX_MARGIN>=4&&CORE2.BACKOUT_AFTER>=6))issues.push('constants');
 if(TrafficSignalController.core!==2)issues.push('signals not on Signal Core v2');
 return{ok:issues.length===0,issues:issues.slice(0,12),passThrough:TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.size,approachesChecked:checked,deg2:deg2.length}
}
// GATE-75 S3: right turns on Road Core v2 — the curve joins the two lane lines around their intersection (lane-intersection fillet), radius
// ≤ CORE2.R_RIGHT (38 px), exit on the outer lane, tangent to both lanes (no wrong-way pre-turn: the curve starts along the approach heading)
function rightTurnAudit2(){
 const issues=[];let n=0;const hd=(a,b)=>{let d=Math.abs(a-b)%(2*Math.PI);return d>Math.PI?2*Math.PI-d:d};
 if(!(CORE2.R_RIGHT<=38))issues.push('R_RIGHT '+CORE2.R_RIGHT);
 for(const m of MOVES2.values()){if(m.kind!=='right')continue;n++;
  if(m.to.k!==m.to.cnt-1)issues.push(m.id+': not the outer exit lane');
  const p=m.pts;if(p.length<3)continue;const h0=Math.atan2(p[1].y-p[0].y,p[1].x-p[0].x),h1=Math.atan2(p[p.length-1].y-p[p.length-2].y,p[p.length-1].x-p[p.length-2].x);
  if(hd(h0,m.from.heading)>.35)issues.push(m.id+': curve leaves against the approach');if(hd(h1,m.to.heading)>.35)issues.push(m.id+': curve joins against the exit')}
 if(!n)issues.push('no right-turn movements');
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,8),rightTurns:n}
}

function trafficDrive(car,dt,desired,lead){
 const reserve=lead?TRAFFIC_FOLLOW_GAP+Math.min(12,car.speed*.09):0,safeGap=lead?Math.max(0,lead.gap-reserve):Infinity;
 if(lead)desired=Math.min(desired,Math.sqrt(2*TRAFFIC_DECEL*safeGap)+(safeGap>0?2:0));
 const openRoad=!lead||lead.gap>Math.max(86,car.speed*.82+34),restart=openRoad&&car.speed<22;
 const accel=(car.recoveryBoost>0?TRAFFIC_RESTART_ACCEL*1.08:restart?TRAFFIC_RESTART_ACCEL:openRoad?TRAFFIC_ACCEL:TRAFFIC_ACCEL*.72);
 if(car.recoveryBoost>0)car.recoveryBoost=Math.max(0,car.recoveryBoost-dt);
 if(desired<car.speed)car.speed=Math.max(desired,car.speed-TRAFFIC_BRAKE_MAX*dt);else car.speed=Math.min(desired,car.speed+accel*dt);
 return safeGap
}

const TRAFFIC_TURN_R=56;
function trafficTurnR(e,nextEdge){const l1=Math.hypot(byNode[e.b].x-byNode[e.a].x,byNode[e.b].y-byNode[e.a].y),l2=Math.hypot(byNode[nextEdge.b].x-byNode[nextEdge.a].x,byNode[nextEdge.b].y-byNode[nextEdge.a].y);return Math.max(18,Math.min(TRAFFIC_TURN_R,l1*.4,l2*.4))}
function trafficSignedTurn(a,b){return Math.atan2(Math.sin(b-a),Math.cos(b-a))}
function trafficLaneIntersection(p1,h1,p2,h2){
 const u1={x:Math.cos(h1),y:Math.sin(h1)},u2={x:Math.cos(h2),y:Math.sin(h2)},cross=u1.x*u2.y-u1.y*u2.x;if(Math.abs(cross)<1e-5)return null;
 const dx=p2.x-p1.x,dy=p2.y-p1.y,t=(dx*u2.y-dy*u2.x)/cross;return{x:p1.x+u1.x*t,y:p1.y+u1.y*t,u1,u2}
}
function trafficPlanTo(car,e,next,dirSign=car.dirSign){
 if(!next?.edge)return null;
 const baseR=trafficTurnR(e,next.edge),l1=Math.hypot(byNode[e.b].x-byNode[e.a].x,byNode[e.b].y-byNode[e.a].y),l2=Math.hypot(byNode[next.edge.b].x-byNode[next.edge.a].x,byNode[next.edge.b].y-byNode[next.edge.a].y),h0=trafficEdgePoint(e.id,dirSign,.5,0).heading,h1=trafficEdgePoint(next.edge.id,next.dirSign,.5,0).heading,delta=trafficSignedTurn(h0,h1),right=delta>.25&&delta<2.75,left=delta<-.25&&delta>-2.75,ang=Math.abs(delta),R=right?Math.min(baseR,38):left?Math.min(baseR,58):baseR;
 const sourceLane=e.cls==='main'?(right?2:left?0:trafficPreferredLane(car,e)):e.cls==='arterial'?(right?1:left?0:trafficPreferredLane(car,e)):0;
 const nextLane=next.edge.cls==='main'?(right?2:left?0:trafficPreferredLane(car,next.edge)):next.edge.cls==='arterial'?(right?1:left?0:(e.cls==='arterial'?sourceLane:trafficPreferredLane(car,next.edge))):0;
 const hin=trafficEdgePoint(e.id,dirSign,.5,sourceLane).heading,hout=trafficEdgePoint(next.edge.id,next.dirSign,.5,nextLane).heading;
 let ts=1-R/Math.max(l1,1),te=R/Math.max(l2,1),rightGeom=null;
 if(right){
  const pin=trafficEdgePoint(e.id,dirSign,1,sourceLane),pout=trafficEdgePoint(next.edge.id,next.dirSign,0,nextLane),g=trafficLaneIntersection(pin,hin,pout,hout);
  if(g){const d=R,from={x:g.x-g.u1.x*d,y:g.y-g.u1.y*d,heading:hin},to={x:g.x+g.u2.x*d,y:g.y+g.u2.y*d,heading:hout},din=(pin.x-from.x)*g.u1.x+(pin.y-from.y)*g.u1.y,dout=(to.x-pout.x)*g.u2.x+(to.y-pout.y)*g.u2.y,nts=1-din/Math.max(l1,1),nte=dout/Math.max(l2,1),arcR=d/Math.max(.18,Math.tan(ang/2)),k=Math.max(5,(4/3)*Math.tan(ang/4)*arcR);
   if(nts>.015&&nts<.985&&nte>.015&&nte<.985){ts=nts;te=nte;rightGeom={from,to,c1:{x:from.x+g.u1.x*k,y:from.y+g.u1.y*k},c2:{x:to.x-g.u2.x*k,y:to.y-g.u2.y*k},k}}
  }
 }
 const nodeId=dirSign>0?e.b:e.a,passThrough=TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.has(nodeId)&&next.edge.id!==e.id&&ang<2.5,boxHalf=passThrough?0:trafficBoxHalf(nodeId,e.id);
 return{next,R,ts,te,ang,delta,right,left,sourceLane,nextLane,rightGeom,cap:ang<.2?car.targetSpeed:ang>2.5?24:right?34:ang>1?38:52,nodeId,dirIn:dirSign,passThrough,boxHalf}
}
function trafficHeadingDiff(a,b){return Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin((a||0)-(b||0)),Math.cos((a||0)-(b||0))))}

// ===== v1.88 · bus freeze watchdog + anti pile-up recovery =============================================
const BUS_FREEZE_RECOVER_SECONDS=9.5;

var __BRM;
function busRouteMetrics(bus){
 const route=busRouteForLine(bus.line);let T=(__BRM||(__BRM=new WeakMap())).get(route);
 if(!T||T.n!==route.length){const L=[],cum=[0];let s=0;for(let i=0;i<route.length;i++){const e=byEdge[route[i].edgeId],a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],l=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y));L.push(l);s+=l;cum.push(s)}T={n:route.length,L,cum,total:s};(__BRM||(__BRM=new WeakMap())).set(route,T)}
 const ri=bus.routeIndex;let pos;
 if(!Number.isInteger(ri)){pos=0;for(let i=0;i<route.length;i++){if(i<ri)pos+=T.L[i];else if(i===ri)pos+=T.L[i]*clamp(bus.t||0,0,1)}}
 else if(ri>=route.length)pos=T.cum[route.length];else if(ri>=0)pos=T.cum[ri]+T.L[ri]*clamp(bus.t||0,0,1);else pos=0;
 return{total:T.total,pos}
}
function busGapAheadSameLine(bus){
 const m=busRouteMetrics(bus);let best=Infinity;
 for(const o of BUS_VEHICLES){if(o===bus||o.line!==bus.line||o.term)continue;const q=busRouteMetrics(o);let d=q.pos-m.pos;if(d<=0)d+=m.total;if(d<best)best=d}
 return best
}
function busAntiBunchCap(bus){
 const gap=busGapAheadSameLine(bus);
 // Preserve a visible headway: below 150 px crawl/hold, then smoothly regain cruise by ~360 px.
 if(!Number.isFinite(gap))return bus.targetSpeed;
 if(gap<=105)return 0;
 if(gap<180)return 18+(gap-105)*.18;
 if(gap<360)return 32+(gap-180)*.18;
 return bus.targetSpeed
}
// GATE-75 S3: the bus lines run inside TrafficCore2.tick (one clock); the previous engine's bus stepping is gone
function busPhysOf(o){return o&&o.phys?BUS_PHYS.find(q=>q.id===o.phys):null}
function busPhysWaiting(o){return o.phys?ALL_BUS_STOPS.reduce((a,s)=>a+(s.phys===o.phys?busPassengerStop(s.id).waiting:0),0):busPassengerStop(o.id).waiting}
/* TCSTOP v2 (p584: the sign smaller, low, beside the shelter) · v1 — p58x (D‑470, the owner 4.11 11:57 / 12:02): the new street bus stop in the game's 3/4 view.
   A clear shelter (no dark box): a glass back and one glass end, two posts, a clear glass roof (as the E3 station roof, LIKE-02) — every
   waiting person shows; a real bench of 4 seats (wood slats, armrests between the seats) — the men sit on it (P34 act 'bench'); who has no
   seat stands in one straight row on the platform beside the shelter, toward the bus's front door — never on the road, in the bay or
   through the bench; one stop pole: the line plate (each number in its line's colour, BUS_LINE_COLORS), the arrival board (line · minutes)
   and the number of waiting people (the number is the truth — more than are drawn may wait). At night the roof light and the board glow.
   The projection, the sun and the colour ramp of C34 / P34 / KIT34: screen = (x, y − K·z), K 0.6, 10 px a metre; street furniture ×1.45
   (KIT34.small), so the bench fits the people (P34 ×1.45).
   Units: a stop frame — s metres along the road in the bus's direction (u), d metres from the road's centre line outward (n), z up.
   The bay (BUS_BAY: entry 4, stop 15, exit 4, depth 3 m) and its platform (2 m behind it) are the game's and do not change (rule 24).
   API: TCSTOP.layout(st) → the seats, the row, the pole (world px) · TCSTOP.draw(g, st, o) — st {x, y (the road's centre at the stop),
   ux, uy, nx, ny, half (px), lines [], waiting, eta {line: minutes|null}, sample}, o {zoom, res, night 0…1, t (s), P34, looks []}. */
var TCSTOP = (function () {
  'use strict';
  const K = .6, M = 10, TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const nrm = v => { const n = Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) || 1; return [v[0] / n, v[1] / n, v[2] / n] };
  const dot = (a, b) => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
  const LD = nrm([-0.42, -0.55, 0.72]), VW = nrm([0, K, 1]), HV = nrm([LD[0] + VW[0], LD[1] + VW[1], LD[2] + VW[2]]);
  const AMB = .62, DIF = .38, TOPB = AMB + DIF * LD[2];
  const MAT = { paint: [.18, 10], metal: [.38, 16], glass: [.7, 28], wood: [.05, 6], stone: [.03, 4], matte: [0, 1] };
  function lit(n, mat) { let b = (AMB + DIF * Math.max(0, dot(n, LD))) / TOPB; if (n[2] < 0) b *= 1 + .3 * n[2]; const m = MAT[mat] || MAT.matte; if (m[0]) b += m[0] * Math.pow(Math.max(0, dot(n, HV)), m[1]); return b }
  const hexRGB = h => { const n = parseInt(h.slice(1), 16); return [n >> 16 & 255, n >> 8 & 255, n & 255] };
  const litC = (hex, b) => { const c = hexRGB(hex); if (b <= 1) return `rgb(${c[0] * b + 14 * (1 - b) | 0},${c[1] * b + 17 * (1 - b) | 0},${c[2] * b + 22 * (1 - b) | 0})`; const k = Math.min(1, (b - 1) * .9); return `rgb(${c[0] + (255 - c[0]) * k | 0},${c[1] + (255 - c[1]) * k | 0},${c[2] + (255 - c[2]) * k | 0})` };
  const COL = { frame: '#5b646c', rail: '#7d868e', wood: '#b07d4c', woodD: '#8a5e36', iron: '#3f474e', pole: '#6f7880', fascia: '#c9ced3', blue: '#1f5aa6',
    glass: 'rgba(196,226,242,.20)', glassE: 'rgba(235,248,255,.55)', roof: 'rgba(205,233,247,.24)', roofE: 'rgba(240,250,255,.75)' };
  const LINE_COLORS = { 1: '#2f6fd0', 2: '#28a66a', 3: '#e8892a' };
  const lineColor = l => (typeof BUS_LINE_COLORS !== 'undefined' && BUS_LINE_COLORS[l]) || LINE_COLORS[l] || '#2f6fd0';
  // ---- the layout of a stop (metres in the stop frame; h = the road's half width) ----
  const L = { shA: -4.6, shB: 0, dF: 3.25, dB: 4.85, roofZ: 3.35, wallZ: 2.95, seats: 4, seatW: .95, benchA: -4.2, seatZ: .667, br: .14, pel: .41,
    rowD: 4.0, rowHead: 5.9, rowStep: .85, rowMax: 7, poleS: -4.9, poleD: 3.2, poleZ: 1.0 };   // p584 (the owner 12:55): the stop's sign low, beside the shelter's end (away from the row), at the platform's front
  function frame(st) { const h = st.half / M + (st.dShift || 0), X0 = st.x, Y0 = st.y, ux = st.ux, uy = st.uy, nx = st.nx, ny = st.ny;
    const W = (s, d, z) => [X0 + (ux * s + nx * (h + d)) * M, Y0 + (uy * s + ny * (h + d)) * M - K * (z || 0) * M];
    const G = (s, d) => [X0 + (ux * s + nx * (h + d)) * M, Y0 + (uy * s + ny * (h + d)) * M];
    const key = (s, d) => uy * s + ny * (h + d);
    const N = (a, b) => [a * ux + b * nx, a * uy + b * ny, 0];   // a world normal from (along s, along d)
    return { h, W, G, key, N, ux, uy, nx, ny, face: Math.atan2(-ny, -nx) } }
  function layout(st) { const F = frame(st), seats = [], row = [];
    const dBR = L.dB - L.br, dPel = dBR - L.pel;
    for (let i = 0; i < L.seats; i++) { const s = L.benchA + (i + .5) * L.seatW, p = F.G(s, dPel); seats.push({ s, d: dPel, x: p[0], y: p[1], heading: F.face }) }
    for (let j = 0; j < L.rowMax; j++) { const s = L.rowHead - j * L.rowStep, p = F.G(s, L.rowD); row.push({ s, d: L.rowD, x: p[0], y: p[1], heading: F.face }) }
    const pp = F.G(L.poleS, L.poleD); return { seats, row, pole: { x: pp[0], y: pp[1] }, capacity: seats.length + row.length } }
  // ---- primitives in the stop frame ----
  function quad(g, F, pts, fill, stroke, lw) { g.beginPath(); pts.forEach((p, i) => { const q = F.W(p[0], p[1], p[2]); i ? g.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : g.moveTo(q[0], q[1]) }); g.closePath(); if (fill) { g.fillStyle = fill; g.fill() } if (stroke) { g.strokeStyle = stroke; g.lineWidth = lw || 1; g.stroke() } }
  function box(g, F, s0, s1, d0, d1, z0, z1, col, mat) {
    const faces = [[F.N(1, 0), [[s1, d0, z0], [s1, d1, z0], [s1, d1, z1], [s1, d0, z1]]], [F.N(-1, 0), [[s0, d0, z0], [s0, d1, z0], [s0, d1, z1], [s0, d0, z1]]],
      [F.N(0, 1), [[s0, d1, z0], [s1, d1, z0], [s1, d1, z1], [s0, d1, z1]]], [F.N(0, -1), [[s0, d0, z0], [s1, d0, z0], [s1, d0, z1], [s0, d0, z1]]]];
    for (const [n, q] of faces) if (dot(n, VW) > 1e-4) quad(g, F, q, litC(col, lit(n, mat)));
    quad(g, F, [[s0, d0, z1], [s1, d0, z1], [s1, d1, z1], [s0, d1, z1]], litC(col, lit([0, 0, 1], mat))) }
  function line3(g, F, a, b, col, w) { const p = F.W(...a), q = F.W(...b); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(p[0], p[1]); g.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); g.strokeStyle = col; g.lineWidth = w; g.stroke() }
  function shadowQuad(g, F, pts, a) { g.beginPath(); pts.forEach((p, i) => { const q = F.W(p[0], p[1], 0); const x = q[0] + p[2] * .25 * M, y = q[1] + p[2] * .32 * M; i ? g.lineTo(x, y) : g.moveTo(x, y) }); g.closePath(); g.fillStyle = `rgba(10,14,20,${a})`; g.fill() }
  // ---- the parts ----
  function ground(g, F, o) {   // the shadows on the platform (the roof is glass: a light one, its frame darker)
    const r0 = L.shA - .15, r1 = L.shB + .15, d0 = L.dF - .15, d1 = L.dB + .1, z = L.roofZ;
    shadowQuad(g, F, [[r0, d0, z], [r1, d0, z], [r1, d1, z], [r0, d1, z]], .03);
    shadowQuad(g, F, [[r0, d0, z], [r1, d0, z], [r1, d0 + .2, z], [r0, d0 + .2, z]], .08);
    shadowQuad(g, F, [[L.shA + .05, L.dB - .02, 0], [L.shB - .05, L.dB - .02, 0], [L.shB - .05, L.dB + .03, L.wallZ], [L.shA + .05, L.dB + .03, L.wallZ]], .06);
    const dBR = L.dB - L.br; shadowQuad(g, F, [[L.benchA, dBR - .66, 0], [L.benchA + L.seats * L.seatW, dBR - .66, 0], [L.benchA + L.seats * L.seatW, dBR, L.seatZ], [L.benchA, dBR, L.seatZ]], .14);
    shadowQuad(g, F, [[L.poleS - .05, L.poleD - .05, 0], [L.poleS + .05, L.poleD - .05, 0], [L.poleS + .05, L.poleD + .05, L.poleZ], [L.poleS - .05, L.poleD + .05, L.poleZ]], .2);
    // a tactile line along the platform's kerb (where one waits for the door)
    quad(g, F, [[-7.2, 3.05, 0], [7.2, 3.05, 0], [7.2, 3.32, 0], [-7.2, 3.32, 0]], 'rgba(214,180,66,.55)') }
  function glassPanel(g, F, a, b, z0, z1, night) {   // a vertical pane from a (s, d) to b (s, d)
    quad(g, F, [[a[0], a[1], z0], [b[0], b[1], z0], [b[0], b[1], z1], [a[0], a[1], z1]], COL.glass, COL.glassE, .9);
    line3(g, F, [a[0], a[1], z0 + (z1 - z0) * .48], [b[0], b[1], z0 + (z1 - z0) * .48], 'rgba(255,255,255,.38)', 1.1);   // the frosted band
    line3(g, F, [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * .08, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * .08, z1 - .25], [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * .3, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * .3, z0 + .5], 'rgba(255,255,255,.22)', 1.4);   // a glint
    line3(g, F, [a[0], a[1], z0], [b[0], b[1], z0], litC(COL.rail, 1.05), 1.6); line3(g, F, [a[0], a[1], z1], [b[0], b[1], z1], litC(COL.rail, 1.1), 1.6); void night }
  function benchBase(g, F) { const dBR = L.dB - L.br, s0 = L.benchA, s1 = s0 + L.seats * L.seatW, z = L.seatZ;
    for (let i = 0; i <= L.seats; i++) { const s = s0 + i * L.seatW; box(g, F, s - .04, s + .04, dBR - .56, dBR - .48, 0, z - .05, COL.iron, 'metal'); box(g, F, s - .04, s + .04, dBR - .06, dBR + .02, 0, z - .05, COL.iron, 'metal') }
    box(g, F, s0, s1, dBR - .62, dBR - .02, z - .1, z - .06, COL.iron, 'metal');
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { const a = dBR - .02 - k * .21, b = a - .18; box(g, F, s0 - .05, s1 + .05, b, a, z - .05, z, COL.wood, 'wood') } }
  function benchBack(g, F, i) { const dBR = L.dB - L.br, s0 = L.benchA + i * L.seatW, s1 = s0 + L.seatW;   // one seat's back, its arm(s)
    for (const zz of [[.86, .98], [1.04, 1.16]]) box(g, F, s0 + (i ? 0 : -.05), s1 + (i === L.seats - 1 ? .05 : 0), dBR, dBR + .07, zz[0], zz[1], COL.wood, 'wood');
    box(g, F, s0 + .42, s0 + .53, dBR + .03, dBR + .09, L.seatZ, 1.16, COL.iron, 'metal') }
  function arm(g, F, s) { const dBR = L.dB - L.br; box(g, F, s - .035, s + .035, dBR - .5, dBR, .9, .95, COL.iron, 'metal'); box(g, F, s - .03, s + .03, dBR - .5, dBR - .44, L.seatZ, .92, COL.iron, 'metal') }
  function post(g, F, s, d) { box(g, F, s - .07, s + .07, d - .07, d + .07, 0, L.roofZ, COL.frame, 'metal') }
  function roof(g, F, o) { const r0 = L.shA - .15, r1 = L.shB + .15, d0 = L.dF - .15, d1 = L.dB + .1, z = L.roofZ, n = 4, w = (r1 - r0) / n;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = r0 + i * w + .03, b = a + w - .06; quad(g, F, [[a, d0 + .05, z], [b, d0 + .05, z], [b, d1 - .03, z], [a, d1 - .03, z]], COL.roof, COL.roofE, .8);
      line3(g, F, [a + .12, d1 - .25, z], [a + .45, d0 + .3, z], 'rgba(255,255,255,.32)', 1.3) }
    for (const s of [L.shA + .07, L.shB - .07]) box(g, F, s - .05, s + .05, d0, d1, z - .05, z + .05, COL.frame, 'metal');   // the two beams over the posts
    box(g, F, r0, r1, d1 - .08, d1, z - .06, z + .06, COL.frame, 'metal');
    box(g, F, r0, r1, d0, d0 + .1, z - .14, z + .08, COL.fascia, 'metal');   // the front edge, with the city's blue line
    line3(g, F, [r0 + .1, d0, z - .04], [r1 - .1, d0, z - .04], COL.blue, 1.6) }
  // ---- the pole: the line plate, the arrival board, the waiting number (sizes on the screen: px · k / zoom) ----
  function panelSize(lines, k, sample) { return { w: 54 * k, sign: 15 * k, row: 9 * k, board: (Math.max(1, lines.length) * 9 + 4.5 + (sample ? 5 : 0)) * k, count: 10.5 * k, gap: 1.2 * k } }   // p584: ~25 % smaller again (the owner 12:55)   // p581: ~16 % smaller (the owner 12:29)
  function rr(g, x, y, w, h, r) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x + r, y); g.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r); g.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r); g.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r); g.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r); g.closePath() }
  function busGlyph(g, x, y, s, col) { g.fillStyle = col; rr(g, x - 7 * s, y - 5 * s, 14 * s, 9 * s, 2 * s); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#1f5aa6'; g.fillRect(x - 5.6 * s, y - 3.6 * s, 11.2 * s, 3.4 * s); g.fillStyle = col; g.fillRect(x - .4 * s, y - 3.6 * s, .8 * s, 3.4 * s);
    g.beginPath(); g.arc(x - 4 * s, y + 4.2 * s, 1.5 * s, 0, TAU); g.arc(x + 4 * s, y + 4.2 * s, 1.5 * s, 0, TAU); g.fill() }
  function personGlyph(g, x, y, s, col) { g.fillStyle = col; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y - 3.6 * s, 1.9 * s, 0, TAU); g.fill(); rr(g, x - 2.6 * s, y - 1.4 * s, 5.2 * s, 6.2 * s, 1.8 * s); g.fill() }
  function panel(g, st, o, x, yTop) {   // (x, yTop): the top of the pole (world px); the panel stands on it, facing the screen
    const z = o.zoom || 1.15, k = Math.max(1, Math.min(1.5, Math.sqrt(z / 1.15))), u = 1 / z, lines = (st.lines || []).slice().sort((a, b) => a - b), S = panelSize(lines, k, st.sample), night = o.night || 0;
    const W = S.w * u, H = (S.sign + S.gap + S.board + S.gap + S.count) * u, side = o.panelSide || 0, x0 = side < 0 ? x - W - 1.5 * k * u : side > 0 ? x + 1.5 * k * u : x - W / 2, y0 = yTop - H;
    g.save(); g.direction = 'ltr'; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
    const two = (first, second, xr, y, gap) => { g.textAlign = 'right'; g.fillText(first, xr, y); g.fillText(second, xr - g.measureText(first).width - gap, y) };   // Hebrew order: the first piece on the right
    if (night > 0) { g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y0 + H / 2, 0, x, y0 + H / 2, W * .9); gr.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,210,120,${.32 * night})`); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,210,120,0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(x - W, y0 - W * .4, 2 * W, H + W * .8); g.restore() }
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,20,.28)'; rr(g, x0 + 1.5 * u, y0 + 2 * u, W, H, 4 * k * u); g.fill();
    // the line plate: blue, the bus sign on the right, a tile per line in its colour
    let y = y0; g.fillStyle = COL.blue; rr(g, x0, y, W, S.sign * u, 3.5 * k * u); g.fill(); g.strokeStyle = '#f4f6f8'; g.lineWidth = 1.2 * k * u; rr(g, x0 + 1.2 * k * u, y + 1.2 * k * u, W - 2.4 * k * u, S.sign * u - 2.4 * k * u, 2.6 * k * u); g.stroke();
    busGlyph(g, x0 + W - 8.5 * k * u, y + S.sign * u / 2, .62 * k * u, '#f4f6f8');
    const tw = 12.5 * k * u, th = 11 * k * u, tg = 2 * k * u, tx1 = x0 + W - 17 * k * u;
    lines.forEach((l, i) => { const tx = tx1 - (i + 1) * tw - i * tg, ty = y + (S.sign * u - th) / 2; g.fillStyle = (st.colors && st.colors[l]) || lineColor(l); rr(g, tx, ty, tw, th, 3 * k * u); g.fill(); g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.9)'; g.lineWidth = 1 * k * u; g.stroke();
      g.fillStyle = '#fff'; g.font = `800 ${9.5 * k * u}px Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif`; g.textAlign = 'center'; g.fillText(String(l), tx + tw / 2, ty + th / 2 + .6 * k * u) });
    // the arrival board: black, amber light
    y += (S.sign + S.gap) * u; g.fillStyle = '#121619'; rr(g, x0, y, W, S.board * u, 3 * k * u); g.fill(); g.strokeStyle = '#3a4148'; g.lineWidth = 1.2 * k * u; g.stroke();
    const amber = night > .3 ? '#ffd27a' : '#ffbf3c';
    lines.forEach((l, i) => { const ry = y + (2.2 + i * 9 + 4.5) * k * u; g.fillStyle = (st.colors && st.colors[l]) || lineColor(l); g.fillRect(x0 + W - 6 * k * u, ry - 3 * k * u, 3 * k * u, 6 * k * u);
      g.font = `700 ${8.2 * k * u}px Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif`; g.fillStyle = amber; two('קו', String(l), x0 + W - 9.5 * k * u, ry + .5 * k * u, 2.2 * k * u);
      const m = st.eta ? st.eta[l] : null, xr = x0 + 25 * k * u; if (m == null) { g.textAlign = 'right'; g.fillText('—', xr, ry + .5 * k * u) } else if (m <= 0) { g.textAlign = 'right'; g.fillText('מגיע', xr, ry + .5 * k * u) } else two(String(m), 'דק׳', xr, ry + .5 * k * u, 2.2 * k * u) });
    if (st.sample) { g.font = `600 ${5.5 * k * u}px Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif`; g.textAlign = 'center'; g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.55)'; g.fillText('דוגמה', x0 + W * .5, y + S.board * u - 2.8 * k * u) }
    // the waiting number (the truth: may be more than are drawn)
    y += (S.board + S.gap) * u; g.fillStyle = '#f4f6f8'; rr(g, x0, y, W, S.count * u, 3 * k * u); g.fill(); g.strokeStyle = '#26323d'; g.lineWidth = 1.2 * k * u; g.stroke();
    personGlyph(g, x0 + W - 6.5 * k * u, y + S.count * u / 2 + .5 * k * u, .72 * k * u, '#26323d');
    g.fillStyle = '#26323d'; g.font = `800 ${8.6 * k * u}px Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif`; two(String(st.waiting | 0), 'ממתינים', x0 + W - 11 * k * u, y + S.count * u / 2 + .6 * k * u, 2.5 * k * u);
    g.restore(); return { x0, y0, w: W, h: H } }
  // ---- the whole stop ----
  function draw(g, st, o) { o = Object.assign({ zoom: 1.15, res: 1.15, night: 0, t: 0 }, o || {}); o.st = st; const F = frame(st), Lo = layout(st), night = o.night || 0, P = o.P34, looks = o.looks || [];
    const n = Math.max(0, st.waiting | 0), nSeat = Math.min(Lo.seats.length, n), nRow = Math.min(Lo.row.length, n - nSeat);
    ground(g, F, o);
    benchBase(g, F);
    const Q = [];   // the painter's list, by the depth on the screen (the y of the ground)
    Q.push([F.key((L.shA + L.shB) / 2, L.dB + .05), () => glassPanel(g, F, [L.shA + .07, L.dB], [L.shB - .07, L.dB], .14, L.wallZ, night)]);
    Q.push([F.key(L.shA + .02, (L.dF + L.dB) / 2 + .35), () => glassPanel(g, F, [L.shA + .02, L.dB - .05], [L.shA + .02, L.dF + .55], .14, L.wallZ, night)]);
    for (const s of [L.shA + .07, L.shB - .07]) Q.push([F.key(s, L.dB), () => post(g, F, s, L.dB)]);
    for (let i = 0; i < L.seats; i++) Q.push([F.key(L.benchA + (i + .5) * L.seatW, L.dB - L.br + .02) - 1e-3, () => benchBack(g, F, i)]);
    for (let i = 0; i <= L.seats; i++) { const s = L.benchA + i * L.seatW; Q.push([F.key(s, L.dB - L.br - .25) - 2e-3, () => arm(g, F, s)]) }
    const res = o.res || o.zoom, man = (p, i, act, ph) => () => { if (o.person) { o.person(p, i, act.k, ph); return } if (!P) return; const look = looks[(i + (st.seed | 0)) % Math.max(1, looks.length)] || {}; P.draw(g, p.x, p.y, look, act, p.heading, ph, res, 'flat') };
    for (let i = 0; i < nSeat; i++) Q.push([F.key(Lo.seats[i].s, Lo.seats[i].d) + 1e-3, man(Lo.seats[i], i, { k: 'bench' }, 0), 1]);

// v1.89: three line-3 stops sit on R-EAST edges (D4-RE-C, D5-GATE-V) shorter than two junction clearances, so no position on them can pass the junction rule.
// The audit accepts the fallback frame only when that is true of the whole edge AND the frame itself is clear of blockers, parking and crosswalks.
function busShortEdgeFallbackOk(o){
 for(let t=.03;t<.98;t+=.02)if(busSiteClear(o.edgeId,o.dirSign,t))return false;
 const F=busSiteFrame(o.edgeId,o.dirSign,o.t),half=F.roadW/2;
 for(let s=-busSiteBack(F.rx,F.ry);s<=busSiteFwd(F.rx,F.ry);s+=9)for(const d of[5,10,15]){const x=F.rx+F.ux*s+F.nx*(half+d),y=F.ry+F.uy*s+F.ny*(half+d);if(staticPersonBlockedAt(x,y,4)||parkingInfoAt(x,y))return false}
 for(const c of CROSSWALKS)if(Math.hypot(c.x-F.rx,c.y-F.ry)<64)return false;
 return true}
function busStopGeometryAudit(){return ALL_BUS_STOPS.filter(o=>!o.terminal).map(o=>{const I=TurboCity.info('PR-35',{scale:BUS_STOP_SHELTER_SCALE,rot:o.rot}),depth=Math.abs(o.nx)>.5?I.fp[2]:I.fp[3],off=o.bay?BUS_BAY.depth+10:10,inner=o.roadHalf+off-depth/2,outer=o.roadHalf+off+depth/2,sidewalkOk=inner>=o.roadHalf+(o.bay?BUS_BAY.depth:0)-.6&&outer<=o.roadHalf+off+10.6,orientOk=o.rot===busShelterRot(o.nx,o.ny),F=busSiteClear(o.edgeId,o.dirSign,o.t,o.shortPad),clearOk=(!!F&&o.siteOk)||(!o.siteOk&&busShortEdgeFallbackOk(o)),dx=o.x-o.roadX,dy=o.y-o.roadY,offsetOk=Math.abs(Math.hypot(dx,dy)-(o.roadHalf+off))<.5;return{id:o.id,line:o.line,edge:o.edgeId,rot:o.rot,inner:+inner.toFixed(1),outer:+outer.toFixed(1),sidewalkOk,orientOk,clearOk,offsetOk,ok:sidewalkOk&&orientOk&&clearOk&&offsetOk}})}

function parkedNearIdx(cars,x,y,R){
 if(!(cars===__apcInfo||(__pslC&&cars===__pslC.list))||!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y))return -1;
 let G=__PNG.get(cars);if(!G||G.n!==cars.length){const C=256,cells=new Map(),odd=[];for(let i=0;i<cars.length;i++){const o=cars[i];if(!Number.isFinite(o.x)||!Number.isFinite(o.y)){odd.push(i);continue}const k=(Math.floor(o.x/C)+4096)*8192+(Math.floor(o.y/C)+4096);let a=cells.get(k);if(!a){a=[];cells.set(k,a)}a.push(i)}G={n:cars.length,C,cells,odd};__PNG.set(cars,G)}
 const C=G.C,cx0=Math.floor((x-R)/C),cx1=Math.floor((x+R)/C),cy0=Math.floor((y-R)/C),cy1=Math.floor((y+R)/C);let n=0,parts=0;
 for(let cx=cx0;cx<=cx1;cx++)for(let cy=cy0;cy<=cy1;cy++){const a=G.cells.get((cx+4096)*8192+(cy+4096));if(!a)continue;parts++;if(n+a.length>__PNB.length){const b=new Int32Array(Math.max(__PNB.length*2,n+a.length));b.set(__PNB);__PNB=b}for(let j=0;j<a.length;j++)__PNB[n++]=a[j]}
 if(G.odd.length){parts++;if(n+G.odd.length>__PNB.length){const b=new Int32Array(Math.max(__PNB.length*2,n+G.odd.length));b.set(__PNB);__PNB=b}for(const i of G.odd)__PNB[n++]=i}
 if(parts>1)for(let i=1;i<n;i++){const v=__PNB[i];let j=i-1;while(j>=0&&__PNB[j]>v){__PNB[j+1]=__PNB[j];j--}__PNB[j+1]=v}
 return n}

function validateSave(d){const errors=[];if(!d||typeof d!=='object')return{ok:false,errors:['not-object']};if(d.metadata?.saveVersion!==SAVE_VERSION)errors.push('saveVersion');

 if(v&&!worldContains(v.x,v.y))errors.push('vehicle.position.bounds');if(p&&Number.isFinite(p.x)&&Number.isFinite(p.y)&&!worldContains(p.x,p.y))errors.push('player.position.bounds');if(typeof d.player?.money!=='number')errors.push('player.money');
 if(!d.garage||!Array.isArray(d.garage.vehicles))errors.push('garage');if(!d.home||!Number.isInteger(d.home.homeLevel))errors.push('home');if(!d.progression||!Array.isArray(d.progression.discoveredChunks))errors.push('progression');

function pointRoad(x,y){
 for(const e of EDGES){const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],t=roadType(e),h=t.width/2;if(Math.abs(a.y-b.y)<.01){if(x>=Math.min(a.x,b.x)&&x<=Math.max(a.x,b.x)&&Math.abs(y-a.y)<=h)return e}else if(y>=Math.min(a.y,b.y)&&y<=Math.max(a.y,b.y)&&Math.abs(x-a.x)<=h)return e}
 for(const n of NODES.filter(n=>incident(n.id).length>1)){const r=Math.max(...incident(n.id).map(e=>roadType(e).width/2));if(Math.hypot(x-n.x,y-n.y)<=r)return incident(n.id)[0]}

function mapBaseFinish(){

// called from frame() right before render(now): the tile is drawn on the main canvas and copied away; render() then repaints the whole canvas in the same frame
function mapBaseStep(now){
 const B=MAPBASE;if(now<1500)return;
 if(!B.total){mapBaseReset();return}
 if(B.done){if(B.key!==mapBaseKey())mapBaseReset();return}
 if(cv.width!==B.cw||cv.height!==B.ch){mapBaseReset();return}
 const t0=performance.now(),k=B.next,col=k%B.cols,row=(k/B.cols)|0,tx=B.x+col*B.tw,ty=B.y+row*B.th,s=B.scale,sv={x:Camera.x,y:Camera.y,zoom:Camera.zoom};
 Camera.x=tx+B.tw/2;Camera.y=ty+B.th/2;Camera.zoom=s/dpr;
 ctx.save();ctx.setTransform(s,0,0,s,0,0);ctx.translate(-tx,-ty);ctx.fillStyle='#0a1218';ctx.fillRect(tx,ty,B.tw,B.th);
 B.pass=true;try{mapBaseLayers(now)}catch(e){B.errors++;B.lastError=String(e&&e.message||e)}finally{B.pass=false}
 ctx.restore();
 for(const r of mapBakeRegions()){const x0=Math.max(r.x,tx),x1=Math.min(r.x+r.w,tx+B.tw),y0=Math.max(r.y,ty),y1=Math.min(r.y+r.h,ty+B.th);if(x1<=x0||y1<=y0)continue;B.levels[0].ctx.drawImage(cv,(x0-tx)*s,(y0-ty)*s,(x1-x0)*s,(y1-y0)*s,Math.round((x0-B.x)*s),Math.round((y0-B.y)*s),Math.round((x1-x0)*s),Math.round((y1-y0)*s))}
 Camera.x=sv.x;Camera.y=sv.y;Camera.zoom=sv.zoom;Targets.begin();
 B.next++;if(B.next>=B.total)mapBaseFinish();
 B.tileMs.push(Math.round(performance.now()-t0))}

  else if(w>38){

   if(act){c.textAlign='left';put(q.id,x+6,y+fs+3,'#ffe08a');let lw=fs*2.1;if(w>118){c.font='600 '+Math.max(9,fs-3)+'px Segoe UI,Arial';put(q.name,x+6+fs*1.9,y+fs+3,'rgba(255,244,214,.92)',null,2.6);lw+=c.measureText(q.name).width+4}if(o.rects)o.rects.push({x:x+3,y:y+2,w:lw+4,h:fs+8})}
   else if(!o.dry){c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';c.globalAlpha=.8;mapHaloText(c,q.id,x+w/2,y+h/2-(w>110?fs*.5:0),'rgba(215,228,236,.8)','rgba(6,12,18,.7)',2.6);if(w>110){c.font='600 '+Math.max(9,fs-3)+'px Segoe UI,Arial';mapHaloText(c,q.name,x+w/2,y+h/2+fs*.7,'rgba(190,208,220,.75)','rgba(6,12,18,.7)',2.4)}c.globalAlpha=1}}}
 c.restore()}

// ---- landmark pins: one icon per place, drawn in code (no fonts needed) ----
const MAP_PIN_COLORS={transport:'#3a8fe0',service:'#3aa86a',commerce:'#b562c9',industry:'#d0643b',energy:'#d6b12f',port:'#6c5ce7',home:'#e0a43a',nature:'#1fa3a8'};
const MAP_KIND_CAT={train:'transport',bus:'transport',car:'service',fuel:'service',gear:'service',cross:'service',school:'service',bag:'commerce',hotel:'commerce',office:'commerce',box:'industry',factory:'industry',bolt:'energy',anchor:'port',home:'home',wave:'nature',dot:'service'};
const MAP_MAJOR_PINS=[['E3-STATION','train','תחנת רכבת'],['E3-TERMINAL','bus','מסוף אוטובוסים'],['PLAYER-HOME','home','בית השחקן'],['C2-MALL','bag','קניון'],['D2-HOTEL-1','hotel','המלון הגדול'],['D2-OFFICE-1','office','מגדל המטה'],['B2-LAKE','wave','אגם הפארק'],['D3-DEALER','car','סוכנות רכבים'],['D3-FUEL','fuel','תחנת דלק'],['D3-GARAGE','gear','מוסך'],['D4-DC','box','מרכז הפצה'],['E4-POWER','bolt','תחנת כוח'],['E5-DEPOT','train','חצר רכבות'],['E6-STATION','train','תחנת הנמל'],['E6-BERTH','anchor','רציף עמוק'],['C6-BERTH','anchor','רציף מכולות'],['D6-SERVICE','anchor','מעבורת לאי'],['D5-GATE','anchor','שער הנמל'],['B4-S1','bag','שכונת B4'],['B4-S2','cross','מרפאה'],['B4-S3','school','בית ספר'],['C4-FAB','factory','מפעל C4'],['APT-TERM','plane','שדה תעופה'],['APT-CARGO','box','מטען אווירי'],['APT-HANGARS','gear','האנגרים']];
function mapPinKind(id){
 if(/^APT-/.test(id)){if(/TERM|TOWER|HELI/.test(id))return'plane';if(/CARGO/.test(id))return'box';if(/RENT|PAX|SHORT/.test(id))return'car';if(/FUEL/.test(id))return'fuel';return'gear'}
 if(/^(E6|D6|C6)-/.test(id)){if(/STATION/.test(id))return'train';if(/BERTH|FERRY/.test(id))return'anchor';if(/WORKSHOP|DEPOT/.test(id))return'gear';if(/OFFICE|OPS|CUSTOMS/.test(id))return'office';return'box'}
 if(/HOTEL/.test(id))return'hotel';if(/OFFICE|BANK|POST|CONTROL/.test(id))return'office';if(/PHARMACY|CLINIC|S2$/.test(id))return'cross';
 if(/MALL|SUPER|MINI|MARKET|FISH|CAFE|RESTAURANT|HARDWARE|S1$|KIOSK/.test(id))return'bag';if(/S3$/.test(id))return'school';
 if(/POWER|GRID|SUB$|SOLAR|UTIL|WATER/.test(id))return'bolt';if(/^D5-/.test(id))return'anchor';if(/FUEL/.test(id))return'fuel';if(/GARAGE/.test(id))return'gear';
 if(/TAXI|PARKING|DEALER|IMPORT/.test(id))return'car';if(/STATION|RAIL|SIGNAL|DEPOT$|FREIGHT|STAFF|TERMINAL/.test(id))return'train';if(/HOME/.test(id))return'home';if(/LAKE/.test(id))return'wave';
 if(/WH|DC|DISPATCH|PARCELS|DOCKS|GATE/.test(id))return'box';if(/FAB|WS$/.test(id))return'factory';return'dot'}
let MAP_PINS=null;
function mapPins(){
 if(MAP_PINS)return MAP_PINS;const reg=navPoiRegistry(),out=[],seen=new Set();
 for(const [id,kind,short] of MAP_MAJOR_PINS){const p=reg[id];if(!p)continue;out.push({id,kind,label:short,full:p.label,chunk:p.chunk,x:p.x,y:p.y,major:true});seen.add(id)}
 for(const [id,p] of Object.entries(reg)){if(seen.has(id)||/^(BUS\d|ACT-)/.test(id))continue;out.push({id,kind:mapPinKind(id),label:p.label,full:p.label,chunk:p.chunk,x:p.x,y:p.y,major:false})}
 return MAP_PINS=out}
function mapIcon(c,kind,x,y,r,fill){
 c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r,0,Math.PI*2);c.fillStyle=fill;c.fill();c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,r*.2);c.strokeStyle='#0b1218';c.stroke();
 if(kind==='dot'||r<4.5){c.restore();return}
 const u=r*.5;c.strokeStyle='#fff';c.fillStyle='#fff';c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,r*.15);c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
 const dots=(y0,dx)=>{for(const d of[-dx,dx]){c.beginPath();c.arc(d,y0,u*.17,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill()}};
 switch(kind){
  case'train':c.strokeRect(-.8*u,-u,1.6*u,1.65*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.8*u,-.25*u);c.lineTo(.8*u,-.25*u);c.stroke();dots(.28*u,.4*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.55*u,1.05*u);c.lineTo(-.9*u,1.4*u);c.moveTo(.55*u,1.05*u);c.lineTo(.9*u,1.4*u);c.stroke();break;
  case'bus':c.strokeRect(-u,-.8*u,2*u,1.55*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(u,-.1*u);c.stroke();dots(.95*u,.55*u);break;
  case'home':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-u,0);c.lineTo(0,-.95*u);c.lineTo(u,0);c.stroke();c.strokeRect(-.65*u,0,1.3*u,.95*u);break;
  case'bag':c.strokeRect(-.8*u,-.3*u,1.6*u,1.25*u);c.beginPath();c.arc(0,-.3*u,.48*u,Math.PI,0);c.stroke();break;
  case'hotel':c.font='800 '+(r*1.25)+'px Arial,sans-serif';c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';c.fillText('H',0,r*.07);break;
  case'office':c.strokeRect(-.55*u,-u,1.1*u,2*u);for(const yy of[-.5,0,.5]){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.2*u,yy*u);c.lineTo(.2*u,yy*u);c.stroke()}break;
  case'wave':for(const yy of[-.45,.2]){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-u,yy*u);c.quadraticCurveTo(-.5*u,(yy-.45)*u,0,yy*u);c.quadraticCurveTo(.5*u,(yy+.45)*u,u,yy*u);c.stroke()}break;
  case'car':c.strokeRect(-u,-.15*u,2*u,.8*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.6*u,-.15*u);c.lineTo(-.3*u,-.75*u);c.lineTo(.3*u,-.75*u);c.lineTo(.6*u,-.15*u);c.stroke();dots(.75*u,.55*u);break;
  case'fuel':c.strokeRect(-.65*u,-.95*u,1.15*u,1.9*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.4*u,-.5*u);c.lineTo(.25*u,-.5*u);c.moveTo(.5*u,-.2*u);c.lineTo(.9*u,-.2*u);c.lineTo(.9*u,.6*u);c.stroke();break;
  case'gear':c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,.5*u,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/4;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(Math.cos(a)*.7*u,Math.sin(a)*.7*u);c.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*1.05*u,Math.sin(a)*1.05*u);c.stroke()}break;
  case'box':c.strokeRect(-.8*u,-.8*u,1.6*u,1.6*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.8*u,0);c.lineTo(.8*u,0);c.moveTo(0,-.8*u);c.lineTo(0,.8*u);c.stroke();break;
  case'factory':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-u,.85*u);c.lineTo(-u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(-.35*u,-.6*u);c.lineTo(-.35*u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(.3*u,-.6*u);c.lineTo(.3*u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(u,.85*u);c.closePath();c.stroke();c.beginPath();c.moveTo(.62*u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(.62*u,-.9*u);c.stroke();break;
  case'bolt':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(.25*u,-u);c.lineTo(-.6*u,.15*u);c.lineTo(-.02*u,.15*u);c.lineTo(-.25*u,u);c.lineTo(.6*u,-.2*u);c.lineTo(.02*u,-.2*u);c.closePath();c.fill();break;
  case'anchor':c.beginPath();c.arc(0,-.7*u,.25*u,0,Math.PI*2);c.moveTo(0,-.45*u);c.lineTo(0,.85*u);c.moveTo(-.55*u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(.55*u,-.1*u);c.moveTo(-.85*u,.25*u);c.arc(0,.1*u,.85*u,Math.PI,0,true);c.stroke();break;
  case'cross':c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.4,r*.27);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-.8*u);c.lineTo(0,.8*u);c.moveTo(-.8*u,0);c.lineTo(.8*u,0);c.stroke();break;
  case'plane':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-1.05*u);c.lineTo(.17*u,-.3*u);c.lineTo(u,.25*u);c.lineTo(.17*u,.15*u);c.lineTo(.12*u,.8*u);c.lineTo(.5*u,1.0*u);c.lineTo(0,.9*u);c.lineTo(-.5*u,1.0*u);c.lineTo(-.12*u,.8*u);c.lineTo(-.17*u,.15*u);c.lineTo(-u,.25*u);c.lineTo(-.17*u,-.3*u);c.closePath();c.fill();break;
  case'school':c.strokeRect(-.9*u,-.65*u,1.8*u,1.4*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-.65*u);c.lineTo(0,.75*u);c.stroke();break}
 c.restore()}
// pins with greedy label placement. o: {w,h,labels,minor,mini,sel,hits,rects}
function drawMapPins(c,T,o){
 c.save();const W=o.w,H=o.h,icons=[],labels=(o.rects||[]).slice(),rMaj=o.mini?2.3:o.rMaj||9,rMin=o.rMin||6.2,sel=o.sel,vis=[];
 const hit=(list,x,y,w,h)=>{for(const q of list)if(x<q.x+q.w&&x+w>q.x&&y<q.y+q.h&&y+h>q.y)return true;return false};
 for(const p of mapPins()){
  if(!p.major&&!o.minor&&p.id!==sel)continue;
  const x=T.x(p.x),y=T.y(p.y),r=p.major?rMaj:rMin;if(x<-r||y<-r||x>W+r||y>H+r)continue;
  if(!p.major&&p.id!==sel&&(hit(icons,x-r*.8,y-r*.8,r*1.6,r*1.6)||hit(o.rects||[],x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2)))continue;
  icons.push({x:x-r,y:y-r,w:r*2,h:r*2});vis.push({p,x,y,r})}
 for(const {p,x,y,r} of vis){
  const col=MAP_PIN_COLORS[MAP_KIND_CAT[p.kind]||'service'];
  if(p.id===sel){c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r+4.5,0,Math.PI*2);c.strokeStyle='#fff';c.lineWidth=2;c.stroke();c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r+7.5,0,Math.PI*2);c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,224,138,.65)';c.lineWidth=2;c.stroke()}
  if(r>=4.5&&G7_SHOP_BRAND[p.id])g7LogoPin(c,G7_SHOP_BRAND[p.id].b,x,y,r*2.05);else mapIcon(c,p.kind,x,y,r,col);   /* p353 · p357: one picture */
  if(o.hits)o.hits.push({id:p.id,label:p.full,x,y,r:Math.max(r+5,13)})}
 if(o.labels){const fs=o.fs||11;c.font='600 '+fs+'px Segoe UI,Arial';c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='top';
  for(const {p,x,y,r} of vis){if(!p.major&&p.id!==sel)continue;const t=p.label,tw=c.measureText(t).width+4,lx=x-tw/2,ly=y+r+2;
   if(p.id===sel||(!hit(labels,lx,ly,tw,fs+3)&&!hit(icons.filter(q=>Math.abs(q.x+q.w/2-x)>.5||Math.abs(q.y+q.h/2-y)>.5),lx,ly,tw,fs+3))){labels.push({x:lx,y:ly,w:tw,h:fs+3});mapHaloText(c,t,x,ly,'#f4fbff')}}}
 c.restore()}

// ---- bus lines: dark halo under the colour, so they read on top of the real picture; stops are white-ringed ----
function drawBusLineMap(c,T,o={}){
 const lw=o.lw||2.3,off=o.off||2.6,sr=o.stop||3.4;c.save();c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
 const paths=BUS_LINES.map(line=>{const route=busRouteForLine(line),k=(line-2)*off,p=new Path2D();for(const seg of route){const e=byEdge[seg.edgeId],A=seg.dirSign>0?byNode[e.a]:byNode[e.b],B=seg.dirSign>0?byNode[e.b]:byNode[e.a],dx=B.x-A.x,dy=B.y-A.y,l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,ox=-dy/l*k,oy=dx/l*k;p.moveTo(T.x(A.x)+ox,T.y(A.y)+oy);p.lineTo(T.x(B.x)+ox,T.y(B.y)+oy)}return[line,p]});
 c.strokeStyle='rgba(6,12,18,.8)';c.lineWidth=lw+2.6;for(const [,p] of paths)c.stroke(p);
 for(const [line,p] of paths){c.strokeStyle=BUS_LINE_MAP_COLORS[line];c.lineWidth=lw;c.stroke(p)}
 for(const line of BUS_LINES)for(const st of busStopsForLine(line)){const x=T.x(st.busX),y=T.y(st.busY);c.fillStyle=busLineColor(line);c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,sr,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,sr*.35);c.strokeStyle='#fff';c.stroke();if(o.hits)o.hits.push({id:st.id,label:st.label,x,y,r:Math.max(sr+5,12)})}
 const tx=T.x(5250),ty=T.y(2130),q=Math.max(4.5,sr+1.4);c.fillStyle='#fff';c.strokeStyle='#17324a';c.lineWidth=1.6;c.beginPath();c.rect(tx-q,ty-q,2*q,2*q);c.fill();c.stroke();
 if(o.hits)o.hits.push({id:'BUS1-E3',label:'מסוף האוטובוסים E3',x:tx,y:ty,r:Math.max(q+5,13)});
 for(const b of BUS_VEHICLES){c.fillStyle=busLineColor(b.line);c.beginPath();c.arc(T.x(b.x),T.y(b.y),sr+.8,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.lineWidth=1.2;c.strokeStyle='#fff';c.stroke()}
 c.restore()}
function drawPlayerMap(c,T,size=5){
 const A=playerActor(),x=T.x(A.x),y=T.y(A.y),a=PlayerProfile.mode==='walk'?PlayerPed.heading:PlayerCar.heading,ph=(performance.now()%1700)/1700;
 c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,224,138,'+(.6*(1-ph)).toFixed(3)+')';c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,size*(1.6+ph*2.8),0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();
 c.rotate(a);c.fillStyle='#ffe08a';c.strokeStyle='#071018';c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.5,size*.3);c.lineJoin='round';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(size*1.5,0);c.lineTo(-size,-size*.85);c.lineTo(-size*.45,0);c.lineTo(-size,size*.85);c.closePath();c.stroke();c.fill();c.restore()}
